ITQAN:v2p415/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p415/r4.speaker: author
ITQAN:v2p415/r4.claim: Dhikr can mean admonition or reminder.
ITQAN:v2p415/r4.anchor: والعظة ﴿ فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به ﴾

DAMGHANI:v1p318/r6.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p318/r6.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p318/r6.claim: ʿAdhāb can mean metamorphosis or transformation as punishment.
DAMGHANI:v1p318/r6.anchor: العذاب المسخ قوله تعالى في سورة الاعراف واخذنا الذين ظلموا بعذاب بئيس يعني مسخ

STUDYQURAN:7:intro/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:7:intro/r2.speaker: Al, IJ
STUDYQURAN:7:intro/r2.claim: Al and IJ consider verses 163–167 to have been revealed in Madinah.
STUDYQURAN:7:intro/r2.anchor:
Some,
however, have considered vv. 163–67 to have been revealed in
Madinah (Al, IJ).

STUDYQURAN:7:intro/r27.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:7:intro/r27.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:7:intro/r27.claim: The discussion returns to the Israelites' later disobedience and the future punishments they are said to suffer for it.
STUDYQURAN:7:intro/r27.anchor: the Israelites’ later disobedience and the future punishments they are said to suffer as a result (vv. 159–71)

SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r1.claim: The pronoun in نسوا refers to those forbidden from wrongdoing, and ما is a relative pronoun for the admonition given by the righteous.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r1.anchor: للمنهيين. و " ما " موصولة بمعنى الذي

SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r2.speaker: ابن عطية
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r2.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya says ما could refer to the reminder itself as a verbal noun, or to the thing about which they were reminded.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r2.anchor: قال ابن عطية: " ويحتمل أن يراد به الذكر نفسه

SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r3.speaker: الشيخ
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r3.claim: The Shaykh says Ibn ʿAṭiyya’s two proposed referents do not appear persuasive; the author explains them as the reminder versus its object.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r3.anchor: قال الشيخ: " ولا يظهر لي هذان الاحتمالان

SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r4.speaker: نافع وأبو جعفر وشيبة
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r4.claim: They read بيس with a quiescent yāʾ; four derivations are offered for this and Ibn ʿĀmir’s reading.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r4.anchor: قرأ نافع وأبو جعفر وشيبة: " بيس " بياء ساكنة

SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r5.speaker: ابن عامر
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r5.claim: Ibn ʿĀmir reads بئس with quiescent hamza; the form may be a transferred past verb or an adjective like حلف.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r5.anchor: وابن عامر بهمزة ساكنة، وفيهما أربعة أوجه

SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r6.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r6.claim: One derivation treats the form as an inflected past verb made into a noun and then an adjective, like the Arabic forms cited.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r6.anchor: أن هذا في الأصل فعل ماض سمي به فأعرب

SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r7.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r7.claim: A second derivation treats it as an adjective coined on pattern فعل, like حلف.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r7.anchor: أنه وصف وضع على فعل كحلف

SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r8.speaker: الكسائي
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r8.claim: Al-Kisāʾī derives بيس from بئيس by easing hamza, assimilating the resulting yāʾs, and deleting one after the kasra.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r8.anchor: صار اللفظ بئس، وهو تخريج الكسائي

SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r9.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r9.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r9.claim: Another derivation starts from بئس on pattern كتف, harmonizes bāʾ to the hamza’s kasra, quiesces hamza, then changes it to yāʾ.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r9.anchor: بزنة كتف ثم أتبعت الباء للهمزة في الكسر

SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r10.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r10.speaker: أبو بكر عن عاصم
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r10.claim: Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim reads بيئس with quiescent yāʾ and open hamza, an adjective on pattern فيعل.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r10.anchor: قرأ أبو بكر عن عاصم " بيئس " بياء ساكنة بين باء

SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r11.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r11.speaker: باقي السبعة
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r11.claim: The remaining seven canonical readers use بئيس on pattern رئيس, either an intensive adjective derived from فاعل or a verbal noun used adjectivally.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r11.anchor: وقرأ باقي السبعة بئيس بزنة رئيس. وفيه وجهان

SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r12.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r12.speaker: امرؤ القيس بن عابس الكندي
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r12.claim: Imruʾ al-Qays ibn ʿĀbis al-Kindī’s line uses بيئسا, supporting the adjective analysis.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r12.anchor: وقال امرؤ القيس بن عابس الكندي

SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r13.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r13.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r13.claim: Abū al-Iṣbaʿ al-ʿAdwānī is introduced as a second poetic witness for the two possible analyses of بئيس.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165/r13.anchor: ومثل ذلك في احتمال الوجهين قول أبي الإصبع العدواني

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r1.claim: The line introduced as Abū al-Iṣbaʿ al-ʿAdwānī’s uses بئيسا, witnessing the form.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r1.anchor: حنقا علي ولا أرى لي منهما شرا بئيسا

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r2.speaker: علي وأبو رجاء
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r2.claim: The بئيس reading is also transmitted from ʿAlī and Abū Rajāʾ.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r2.anchor: وهي أيضا قراءة علي وأبي رجاء

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r3.speaker: يعقوب وعيسى بن عمر وزيد بن علي
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r3.claim: Yaʿqūb, ʿĪsā ibn ʿUmar, and Zayd ibn ʿAlī read بئس on the pattern شهد.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r3.anchor: وقرأ يعقوب القارئ: بئس بوزن شهد

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r4.speaker: نصر بن عاصم
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r4.claim: Naṣr ibn ʿĀṣim reads بأس on the pattern ضرب as a past-tense verb.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r4.anchor: وقرأ نصر بن عاصم: بأس بوزن ضرب فعلا ماضيا

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r5.speaker: الأعمش ومالك بن دينار
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r5.claim: Al-Aʿmash and Mālik ibn Dīnār also read بأس as a past verb from بئس with a lightened quiescent hamza; poetry witnesses شهد.

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r6.speaker: ابن كثير وأهل مكة
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r6.claim: Ibn Kathīr and the Meccans read بئس with bāʾ kasra and a lightly pronounced hamza; the hamza’s vowel is unspecified.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r6.anchor: وقرأ ابن كثير وأهل مكة: بئس بكسر الباء والهمز همزا خفيفا

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r7.speaker: طلحة وخارجة عن نافع
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r7.claim: Ṭalḥa and Khārija from Nāfiʿ read بيس with open bāʾ and quiescent yāʾ, deriving it from بيئس by easing and assimilating hamza, then deletion.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r7.anchor: وقرأ طلحة وخارجة عن نافع بيس بفتح الباء وسكون الياء

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r8.speaker: عيسى بن عمر والأعمش وعاصم في رواية
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r8.claim: They read بيئس like Abū Bakr but with hamza kasra; critics object that weak-root فيعل normally has a fatha, though rare counterexamples exist.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r8.anchor: وقرأ عيسى بن عمر والأعمش وعاصم في رواية: بيئس كقراءة أبي بكر

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r9.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r9.speaker: نصر في رواية مالك بن دينار
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r9.claim: Naṣr in Mālik ibn Dīnār’s transmission reads بأس with open bāʾ and hamza and kasra on sīn, on pattern جبل.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r9.anchor: وقرأ نصر في رواية مالك بن دينار عنه " بأس " بفتح الباء والهمزة

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r10.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r10.speaker: أبو عبد الرحمن السلمي وطلحة بن مصرف
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r10.claim: They read بئس on patterns like كبد and حذر; ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Qays’s line attests بئس.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r10.anchor: وقرأ أبو عبد الرحمن السلمي وطلحة بن مصرف " بئس " مثل كبد

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r11.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r11.speaker: نصر بن عاصم
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r11.claim: One Naṣr transmission reads بيس with doubled yāʾ; it may derive from بؤس without hamza or from hamza replaced by yāʾ and assimilated.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r11.anchor: وقرأ نصر بن عاصم في رواية " بيس " بتشديد الياء كميت

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r12.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r12.speaker: نصر بن عاصم
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r12.claim: Another Naṣr transmission has doubled hamza in بأس, explained by changing yāʾ into hamza and assimilating it as a past verb.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r12.anchor: وقرأ أيضا في رواية " بأس " بهمزة مشددة

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r13.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r13.speaker: طائفة أخرى
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r13.claim: Another group reads بأس like the preceding form but with a light hamza.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r13.anchor: وطائفة أخرى: بأس " كالتي قبلها إلا أن الهمزة خفيفة

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r14.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r14.speaker: طائفة
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r14.claim: A further group reads باس with a full alif between bāʾ and sīn.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r14.anchor: وطائفة: " باس " بألف صريحة بين الباء والسين المجرورة

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r15.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r15.speaker: أهل المدينة
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r15.claim: The Medinans read بئيس like رئيس but with bāʾ kasra, a Tamīm dialect in throat-consonant فعيل words.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#2/r15.anchor: وقرأ أهل المدينة: " بئيس " كرئيس، إلا أنهم كسروا الباء

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r1.speaker: الحسن والأعمش
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r1.claim: Al-Ḥasan and al-Aʿmash read بئيس with kasra on yāʾ, quiescent hamza, and open final yāʾ, on patterns حذيم and عثير.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r1.anchor: وقرأ الحسن والأعمش: " بئيس " بياء مكسورة ثم همزة ساكنة

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r2.speaker: الحسن
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r2.claim: Al-Ḥasan reads بئس with bāʾ kasra, quiescent hamza, and open sīn as the verb of blame; this is also transmitted from Abū Bakr.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r2.anchor: وقرأ الحسن: بئس بكسر الباء وسكون الهمزة وفتح السين

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r3.speaker: الحسن
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r3.claim: Al-Ḥasan also reads the form with an explicit yāʾ instead of hamza, similarly parsed and transmitted from Nāfiʿ.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r3.anchor: وقرأ الحسن أيضا كذلك إلا أنه بياء صريحة

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r4.speaker: أبو حاتم
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r4.claim: Abū Ḥātim rejects the two blame-verb readings because بئس requires an expressed complement such as الرجل or رجلا.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r4.anchor: رد أبو حاتم هذه القراءة والتي قبلها بأنه لا يقال

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r5.speaker: النحاس
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r5.claim: Al-Naḥḥās rejects Abū Ḥātim’s objection: Arabic permits an omitted referent, as in فبها ونعمت, meaning a good quality; the implied sense here is a bad punishment.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r5.anchor: قال النحاس: " وهذا مردود يعني قول أبي حاتم

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r6.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r6.claim: The author defends Abū Ḥātim because an overt subject is normally required, though the hadith فبها ونعمت supplies its omitted subject from context.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r6.anchor: قلت: أبو حاتم معذور في [رد] القراءة فإن الفاعل ظاهرا غير مذكور

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r7.speaker: الشيخ
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r7.claim: The Shaykh summarizes twenty-two readings by distinguishing triliteral from quadriliteral forms and, within them, nouns from verbs.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r7.anchor: قال الشيخ: " فهذه اثنتان وعشرون قراءة، وضبطها بالتلخيص

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r8.speaker: أبو البقاء
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r8.claim: Abū al-Baqāʾ adds بيس with open bāʾ and kasra on yāʾ, deriving it from hamza replaced by yāʾ.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r8.anchor: وقد زاد أبو البقاء أربع قراءات أخر: بيس بباء مفتوحة وياء مكسورة

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r9.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r9.speaker: أبو البقاء
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r9.claim: He adds بيس with both bāʾ and yāʾ open, moving hamza’s vowel to yāʾ and deleting it; yāʾ remains because the vowel is incidental.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r9.anchor: وبيس بفتحهما، قال " وأصلها ياء ساكنة وهمزة مفتوحة

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r10.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r10.speaker: أبو البقاء
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r10.claim: He adds بأيس with open bāʾ, quiescent hamza, and open yāʾ, but calls it remote because فعيل is not a word pattern.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r10.anchor: وبأيس بفتح الباء وسكون الهمزة وفتح الياء، قال: " وهو بعيد

SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r11.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r11.speaker: أبو البقاء
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r11.claim: He adds بيآس on the rare pattern فيعال; these additions bring the total to twenty-six readings.
SAMIN-DURR:7:165#3/r11.anchor: وقرئ بيآس على فيعال وهو غريب. فهذه ست وعشرون قراءة

ZAJJAJ:v2p385/r3.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v2p385/r3.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v2p385/r3.claim: Nasū can mean they abandoned what they were reminded of, or that their abandonment was like the act of someone who forgot.
ZAJJAJ:v2p385/r3.anchor: (نسوا) يجوز أن يكون في معنى تركوا، ويجوز أن يكون تركهم بمنزلة من نسي

ZAJJAJ:v2p385/r4.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v2p385/r4.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v2p385/r4.claim: Baʾīs means severe; the verb baʾisa yabʾusu baʾsan is used when something becomes severe.
ZAJJAJ:v2p385/r4.anchor: أي شديد، يقال بئس يبؤس بأسا إذا اشتد

ZAJJAJ:v2p385/r5.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v2p385/r5.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v2p385/r5.claim: One reported account divides the people into three groups: those doing evil, those forbidding it, and those who refrained from forbidding it.
ZAJJAJ:v2p385/r5.anchor: وقيل إن القوم كانوا ثلاث فرق، فرقة عملت بالسوء، وفرقة نهت عن السوء، وفرقة أمسكت عن النهي

ZAJJAJ:v2p385/r6.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v2p385/r6.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v2p385/r6.claim: Another account has two groups, the forbidders and the evildoers; believers among the forbidders who were displeased with evil were saved with them, while Sabbath transgressors were punished.
ZAJJAJ:v2p385/r6.anchor: وقيل كانوا فرقتين، فرقة نهت عن السوء وفرقة عملت بالسوء، وبعض الفرقة التي فيها من نهى عن السوء مؤمن

ASAD-NOTES:7:165#n132/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:7:165#n132/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:7:165#n132/r1.claim: The saved group is described literally as those who were forbidding evil.

FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r1.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r1.speaker: ابن كثير وأبو عمرو وحمزة والكسائي
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r1.claim: They read بئيس on the pattern فعيل, with hamza between bāʾ and yāʾ and tanwīn.
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r1.anchor: فقرأ ابن كثير، وأبو عمرو، وحمزة، والكسائي: بئيس على وزن فعيل

FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r2.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r2.speaker: نافع
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r2.claim: Nāfiʿ’s main reading is بيس with kasra on bāʾ, no hamza, and tanwīn; Abū Qurra reports the فعيل form, while Khārija reports بيس with fatḥa on bāʾ.
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r2.anchor: وقرأ نافع بعذاب بيس بما بكسر الباء من غير همز وينون

FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r3.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r3.speaker: ابن عامر وحفص عن عاصم
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r3.claim: Ibn ʿĀmir reads the hamzated pattern فعل, like Nāfiʿ’s unhamzated form; Ḥafṣ from ʿĀṣim reads بئيس on فعيل like the first group.
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r3.anchor: وقرأ ابن عامر: بعذاب بئس بما على وزن فعل

FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r4.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r4.speaker: حسين الجعفي عن أبي بكر عن عاصم
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r4.claim: A route from Ḥusayn al-Juʿfī reports بيأس on فَيْعَل with an open hamza; Abū Bakr says he doubted his memory of this and stopped transmitting it from ʿĀṣim, taking بئيس from al-Aʿmash instead.
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r4.anchor: وروى حسين الجعفي عن أبي بكر عن عاصم بيأس على وزن فيعل

FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r5.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r5.speaker: أبو زيد
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r5.claim: Abū Zayd distinguishes بؤس الرجل يبؤس بأسا for being intensely formidable from بئس يبأس بؤسا وبيسا وبأسا; البأساء is the noun.
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r5.anchor: قال أبو زيد: قد بؤس الرجل يبؤس بأسا

FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r6.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r6.speaker: author
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r6.claim: بئيس may be a فعيل adjective from بؤس, meaning severe, or a verbal noun used adjectivally for hardship; the latter means punishment possessing distress.
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p98#2/r6.anchor: يحتمل قول من قال: بئيس أمرين: أحدهما أن يكون فعيلا من بؤس

FARISI-HUJJA:v4p100/r1.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p100/r1.speaker: author
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p100/r1.claim: The unhamzated بيس form is a verb-derived expression made into a noun and then used adjectivally, as with قيل وقال; the poet’s تقوال witnesses that nominalized usage.
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p100/r1.anchor: وما روي عن نافع من قوله

FARISI-HUJJA:v4p100/r2.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p100/r2.speaker: سيبويه
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p100/r2.claim: Sibawayh heard Arabs say بيس without articulating hamza; al-Fārisī explains the yāʾ as a resolved hamza because a hamza made quiescent cannot be pronounced between its two states.
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p100/r2.anchor: فإن سيبويه حكى أنه سمع بعض العرب

FARISI-HUJJA:v4p100/r3.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p100/r3.speaker: ابن عامر
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p100/r3.claim: Ibn ʿĀmir’s hamzated بئس matches Nāfiʿ’s بيس except that Ibn ʿĀmir clearly articulates the hamza.
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p100/r3.anchor: وقراءة ابن عامر: بعذاب بئس بالهمز

FARISI-HUJJA:v4p100/r4.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p100/r4.speaker: author
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p100/r4.claim: The reported Asim form بيأس can be analyzed as فَيْعَل, but that pattern normally has a weak second radical; al-Fārisī therefore regards this report from ʿĀṣim or al-Aʿmash as a mistake.
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p100/r4.anchor: فينبغي أن يحمل بيأس على الوهم ممن رواه عن عاصم والأعمش

IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p166/r3.author: Ibn Khālawayh (attr.)
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p166/r3.speaker: author
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p166/r3.claim: The word has five reported reading forms: hamzated baʾīs, hamzated biʾs, bīs with either yāʾ vowel and no hamza, and bayās.
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p166/r3.anchor: يقرا بئيس بالهمزة على وزن فعيل وبئس بإثبات الهمز وحذف الياء على وزن فعل وبيس بكسر الياء وفتحها من غير همز وبيأس بفتح الباء وإسكان الياء وهمزة

IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r3.author: Ibn Mujāhid
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r3.speaker: ابن كثير، أبو عمرو، حمزة، الكسائي
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r3.claim: These readers pronounce بئيس on the faʿīl pattern.
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r3.anchor: فقرأ ابن كثير وأبو عمرو وحمزة والكسائى ﴿ بئيس ﴾ على وزن فعيل

IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r4.author: Ibn Mujāhid
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r4.speaker: نافع
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r4.claim: Nāfiʿ reads بيس with kasra on bāʾ and without hamza; routes from him also report the faʿīl and a fatḥa, unhamzated faʿl form.
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r4.anchor: وقرأ نافع / بيس / بكسر الباء من غير همز

IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r5.author: Ibn Mujāhid
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r5.speaker: نافع عن أبي قرة، خارجة
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r5.claim: Abū Qurra reports بئيس on faʿīl from Nāfiʿ; Khārija reports بيس with fatḥa on bāʾ, no hamza, sukūn yāʾ, and tanwīn, on faʿl.
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r5.anchor: وروى أبو قرة عن نافع ﴿ بئيس ﴾ على وزن فعيل مثل حمزة وروى خارجة عنه / بيس / بفتح الباء

IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r6.author: Ibn Mujāhid
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r6.speaker: ابن عامر
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r6.claim: Ibn ʿĀmir reads بئس on faʿl like Nāfiʿ’s form, but with hamza.
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r6.anchor: وقرأ ابن عامر ﴿ بئس ﴾ على وزن فعل مثل نافع غير أنه مهموز

IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r7.author: Ibn Mujāhid
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r7.speaker: حفص عن عاصم
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r7.claim: Ḥafṣ from ʿĀṣim reads بئيس on faʿīl like Ḥamza.
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r7.anchor: وروى حفص عن عاصم ﴿ بئيس ﴾ مثل حمزة

IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r8.author: Ibn Mujāhid
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r8.speaker: حسين الجعفي عن أبي بكر عن عاصم، أبو البختري عن يحيى عن أبي بكر
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r8.claim: Al-Juʿfī reports an open-hamza fīʿil form from Abū Bakr, but Abū Bakr later doubted it and abandoned that attribution, taking بئيس from al-Aʿmash instead.
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r8.anchor: وروى حسين الجعفى عن أبى بكر عن عاصم / بيئس / على وزن فيعل بفتح الهمز

QIRAAT-ER:7:165:18#1/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:7:165:18#1/r1.speaker: author
QIRAAT-ER:7:165:18#1/r1.claim: Eliding hamza changes baʾīs to bīs, simplifying articulation without semantic change.
QIRAAT-ER:7:165:18#1/r1.anchor: Hamza elision: baʾīs → bīs; simplifies articulation without semantic change

QIRAAT-ER:7:165:18#2/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:7:165:18#2/r1.speaker: author
QIRAAT-ER:7:165:18#2/r1.claim: A compressed short-vowel form may evoke biʾs as an abstract noun of wretchedness rather than an adjective.
QIRAAT-ER:7:165:18#2/r1.anchor: Short vowel + sukūn: compressed form; may evoke biʾs

QIRAAT-ER:7:165:18#3/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:7:165:18#3/r1.speaker: author
QIRAAT-ER:7:165:18#3/r1.claim: The bayʾas variant metathesizes hamza in an archaic morphological pattern while preserving the root consonants.
QIRAAT-ER:7:165:18#3/r1.anchor: Metathesis of hamza: faʿlas pattern; archaic morphological variant preserving root consonants

ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p239#3/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p239#3/r1.speaker: قتادة
ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p239#3/r1.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله تعالى ﴿ بعذاب بئيس ﴾ قال وجيع

ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p240/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p240/r2.speaker: ابن جريج
ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p240/r2.claim: Ibn Jurayj explains that they forgot the believers’ admonition to them, the people referred to in 7:164.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p240/r2.anchor: قال ابن جريج في قوله تعالى ﴿ فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به ﴾ قال فلما نسوا موعظة المؤمنين إياهم الذين قال الله تعالى

ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p240#3/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p240#3/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p240#3/r1.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas recounts that fish came abundantly to Aylah’s Jews on Saturdays; Satan persuaded some that only eating was banned, so they trapped fish on the Sabbath and ate it later, while others held that catching it was also forbidden.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p240#3/r1.anchor: عن عكرمة قال جئت ابن عباس يوما وإذا هو يبكي والمصحف في حجره

ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p240#3/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p240#3/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p240#3/r2.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas says the offenders persisted while one group warned them and another objected to the warnings; when the offenders were found transformed into apes, the apes recognized their human kin and wept.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p240#3/r2.anchor: عن عكرمة قال جئت ابن عباس يوما وإذا هو يبكي والمصحف في حجره

ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p240#3/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p240#3/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p240#3/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas says he sees that those who forbade evil were saved but cannot tell what became of the silent group; when Ikrima argued they had disapproved, Ibn ʿAbbas ordered him two coarse cloaks.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v2p240#3/r3.anchor: عن عكرمة قال جئت ابن عباس يوما وإذا هو يبكي والمصحف في حجره

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r6.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r6.claim: The pronoun in نسوا refers to those warned; neglect is called forgetting for emphasis, since leaving something can reach the extreme of forgetting, and ما is relative.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r6.anchor: الضمير في نسوا للمنهيين أي تركوا ما ذكرهم به الصالحون وجعل الترك نسيانا مبالغة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r7.speaker: ابن عطية
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya proposes that ما may mean the reminder itself or its contents; Abū Ḥayyān says neither possibility is apparent.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r7.anchor: قال ابن عطية: ويحتمل أن يراد به الذكر نفسه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r8.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r8.claim: السوء generally means acts of disobedience, but in this story it specifically means fishing for fish on the Sabbath.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r8.anchor: والسوء عام في المعاصي وبحسب القصص يختص هنا بصيد الحوت

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r9.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r9.claim: Those who were punished are the Sabbath violators; calling them wrongdoers identifies the cause of their seizure.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r9.anchor: والذين ظلموا هم العاصون نبه على العلة في أخذهم وهي الظلم

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r10.speaker: مجاهد
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r10.claim: Mujāhid explains بئيس as severe and painful.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r12.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r12.speaker: نافع وأبو جعفر وشيبة
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r12.claim: Nāfiʿ, Abū Jaʿfar, Shayba, and others read بيس on the pattern of جيد; Ibn ʿĀmir has a hamzated form.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r12.anchor: وقرأ أهل المدينة نافع وأبو جعفر وشيبة وغيرهما بيس على وزن جيد

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r13.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r13.speaker: الكسائي
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r13.claim: Al-Kisāʾī derives the shortened form from بيئس: easing the hamza brings two yāʾs together, so one is deleted and the first vowel is kasra.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r13.anchor: وخرجه الكسائي على وجه آخر وهو أن الأصل بيئس فخفف الهمزة فالتفت ياءان

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r14.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r14.speaker: غيره
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r14.claim: Other grammarians analyze the word on the pattern fiʿl, with an assimilated initial kasra and later hamza reduction.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r14.anchor: وخرجه غيره على أن يكون على وزن فعل فكسر أوله إتباعا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r15.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r15.speaker: الحسن ونافع وأبو بكر
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r15.claim: Al-Ḥasan reads بئيس with and without hamza; Nāfiʿ and Abū Bakr have the comparable unhamzated form.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r15.anchor: وقرأ الحسن بئيس بهمز وبغير همز عن نافع وأبي بكر مثله إلا أنه بغير همز

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r16.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r16.speaker: أبو حاتم
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r16.claim: Abū Ḥātim rejects the unhamzated reading because بيس needs a following noun or predicate, such as بيس الرجل.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r16.anchor: وضعفها أبو حاتم وقال: لا وجه لها

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r17.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r17.speaker: النحاس
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r17.claim: Al-Naḥḥās answers Abū Ḥātim by citing the established ellipsis in فبها ونعمت, where the omitted noun is understood; here the estimate is بيس العذاب.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r17.anchor: قال النحاس: هذا مردود من كلام أبي حاتم

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r18.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r18.speaker: يعقوب القارئ
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r18.claim: Yaʿqūb al-Qāriʾ reports a reading بئس on the pattern of شهد; al-Rāzī attributes it to ʿĪsā ibn ʿUmar.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p208/r18.anchor: وقرىء بئس على وزن شهد حكاها يعقوب القارئ وعزاها أبو الفضل الرازي

ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r1.claim: ‘They forgot’ means they abandoned what the righteous reminded them of and turned away completely; the relative pronoun is apparent, though a verbal noun is possible.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r1.anchor: تركوا ما ذكرهم به صلحاؤهم ترك الناسي للشيء وأعرضوا عنه

ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r2.claim: Forgetfulness figuratively denotes abandonment, preferably as a metaphor comparing disregard with forgetting; a metonymy based on causation is also possible.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r2.anchor: والنسيان مجاز عن الترك واستظهر أنه إستعارة حيث شبه الترك بالنسيان

ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r3.claim: Literal forgetfulness is not intended: it does not incur punishment, and salvation follows deliberate abandonment; the condition implies reminders and refusal to heed them.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r3.anchor: ولم يحمل ظاهره كما قال بعض المحققين لأنه غير واقع ولأنه لايؤاخذ بالنسيان

ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r4.claim: Those forbidding evil includes both questioners and addressed people; the questioners also admonished but stopped when they concluded it would have no effect.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r4.anchor: شامل للذين قالوا لم تعظون الخ وللمقول لهم ذلك

ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r5.speaker: الزمخشري
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r5.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī says one who knows admonition will not affect the listener is relieved of the duty and may have to stop lest it become pointless; he compares warning extortionists robbing the poor.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r5.anchor: قال الزمخشري لدخوله في باب العبث ألا ترى أنك لو ذهبت إلى المكاسين

ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r6.claim: The first group may have stopped from greater certainty that warnings were futile, while the others were less despairing or exceptionally eager and persistent.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r6.anchor: كما وصف الله تعالى رسوله صلى الله تعالى عليه وسلم

ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās said he did not know what became of the silent faction, since the verse saves warners and punishes wrongdoers without naming the silent.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r7.anchor: وروي عن ابن عباس رضي الله تعالى عنهما أنه قال

ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r8.speaker: عكرمة
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r8.claim: ʿIkrima argued that the silent had condemned the wrong, so even though God did not explicitly say He saved them, He did not say He destroyed them; Ibn ʿAbbās was pleased and concluded they were saved.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r8.anchor: عكرمة : جعلني الله فداك ألا تراهم كيف أنكروا

ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r9.speaker: الطبرسي
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r9.claim: Al-Ṭabrisī attributes to Ibn ʿAbbās two other positions: suspend judgment on the silent, or hold they were destroyed; the latter also is attributed to Ibn Zayd and Abū ʿAbd Allāh.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r9.anchor: الطبرسي إليه رضي الله تعالى عنه قولين آخرين في الساكتة

ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r10.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r10.speaker: ابن عباس
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r10.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās glosses baʾīs as punishment without mercy, amounting to severity; most treat the form as adjective or emphatic verbal noun used adjectivally.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#2/r10.anchor: وفسره الحبر بما لا رحمة فيه ويرجع إلى ما ذكر

ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r1.speaker: الراغب
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r1.claim: Al-Rāghib says buʾs, baʾs, and baʾsāʾ mean hardship and adversity; buʾs is especially poverty and war, while baʾs and baʾsāʾ denote punitive calamity.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r1.anchor: الراغب : البؤس والبأس والبأساء الشدة والمكروه

ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r2.speaker: أبو بكر
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r2.claim: Abū Bakr reads biʾays on the fayʿil pattern, comparable to ḍaygham; adding yāʾ to a verbal noun can make a noun or adjective.

ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r3.speaker: عاصم
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r3.claim: A narration from ʿĀṣim has the hamza kasra; al-Ālūsī calls it weak in transmission and grammar, softened by the affinity of hamzated and weak forms.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r3.anchor: عاصم في رواية عنه ( بيئس ) بكسر الهمزة إنها ضعيفة

ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r4.speaker: ابن عامر
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r4.claim: Ibn ʿĀmir reads biʾis with kasra on bāʾ and sukūn on hamza, explained as a shortened form like kabid/kibd and kalima/kilma.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r4.anchor: ابن عامر ( بئس ) بكسر الباء وسكون الهمزة

ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r5.speaker: نافع
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r5.claim: Nāfiʿ reads bīs, turning hamza into yāʾ after sukūn and preceding kasra; another analysis derives it from biʾsa, ‘to blame,’ converted to a noun for loathsome punishment.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r5.anchor: نافع ( بيس ) على قلب الهمزة ياء كما قلبت في ذيب

ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r6.claim: Another bīs reading assimilates the hamza-derived yāʾ, or derives from a wāw-root; further forms include lightened bīs and bāʾis meaning one possessing strength.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r6.anchor: وقريء ( بيس ) كريس وكيس على قلب الهمزة ياء

ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r7.claim: Other readings are reported, with some authorities counting as many as twenty-six variants.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r7.anchor: وقريء غير ذلك وأوصل بعضهم ما فيه من القراءات إلى ست وعشرين

ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r8.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r8.claim: The indefinite ‘punishment’ intensifies its magnitude and horror.

ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r9.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r9.claim: The final causal phrase attaches to ‘We seized,’ as does the earlier cause, without awkwardness because meanings differ; wrongdoing causes seizure and itself constitutes further injustice.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p92#3/r9.anchor: متعلق بأخذنا كالباء الأولى ولا ضير فيه لاختلافهما معنى

BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r1.claim: They forgot means they abandoned what they had been admonished with.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r1.anchor: {فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به} أي: تركوا ما وعظوا به،

BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r2.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r2.claim: God saved those who forbade evil and seized the sinful faction.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r2.anchor: أنجينا الذين ينهون عن السوء وأخذنا الذين ظلموا} يعني الفرقة العاصية،

BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r3.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r3.claim: Baʾis means severe and painful, from baʾs meaning severity.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r3.anchor: {بعذاب بئيس} أي: شديد وجيع، من البأس وهو الشدة.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r4.speaker: أهل المدينة وابن عامر وأبو جعفر ونافع وعاصم والآخرون
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r4.claim: The readings vary: Medinans and Ibn ʿAmir use kasra, with Ibn ʿAmir hamza and Abu Jaʿfar and Nafiʿ without it; Abu Bakr from ʿAsim has ba fatḥa, ya sukun, hamza fatḥa; others follow faʿil like baʿir.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r4.anchor: واختلف القراء فيه قرأ أهل المدينة وابن عامر "بئيس" بكسر الباء على وزن فعل، إلا أن ابن عامر يهمزه، وأبو جعفر ونافع لا يهمزان،

BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r5.speaker: ابن عباس وعكرمة
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r5.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas says he does not know what happened to the silent faction; ʿIkrima argues they objected and disliked the wrongdoing, and Ibn ʿAbbas approves his reasoning and gives him two cloaks.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r5.anchor: قال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما: أسمع الله يقول: "أنجينا الذين ينهون عن السوء وأخذنا الذين ظلموا بعذاب بئيس"، فلا أدري ما فعل بالفرقة الساكتة؟

BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r6.speaker: يمان بن رباب
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r6.claim: Yaman ibn Rabab says both the questioners and those who answered that admonition excused them were saved, while the fish-takers were destroyed; this is Hasan's view.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r6.anchor: وقال يمان بن رباب: نجت 139/ب الطائفتان الذين قالوا لم تعظون قوما والذين قالوا معذرة إلى ربكم،

BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r7.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r7.speaker: ابن زيد
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r7.claim: Ibn Zayd says only the enjoining faction was saved and both other factions perished.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r7.anchor: وقال ابن زيد: نجت الناهية، وهلكت الفرقتان،

BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r8.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r8.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r8.claim: The verse is the strongest warning against abandoning the duty to forbid wrongdoing.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p294/r8.anchor: وهذه أشد آية في ترك النهي عن المنكر.

BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r1.claim: They 'forgot' by abandoning the admonition as if they had forgotten it.

BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r2.claim: This is what their righteous advisers had warned them about.

BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r3.claim: God rescued those who forbade evil and seized the wrongdoers for transgression and disobeying God's command.

BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r4.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r4.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r4.claim: Baʾīs means severe, from the root denoting severity.
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r4.anchor: شديد فعيل من بؤس يبؤس بؤسا إذا اشتد

BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r5.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r5.speaker: أبو بكر، ابن عامر، نافع
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r5.claim: Abū Bakr reads biʾyis on the pattern fiʿayl; Ibn ʿĀmir reads biʾs with a still hamza, also reported as a softened adjective; Nāfiʿ reads bīs by turning hamza to yāʾ or by converting a verb of blame into a name.
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r5.anchor: وقرأ أبو بكر " بيئس " على فيعل كضيغم، وابن عامر «بئس» بكسر الباء

BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r6.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r6.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r6.claim: Other readings assimilate a hamza changed to yāʾ, lighten the form like hayyin, or use bāʾis on the pattern fāʿil.
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r6.anchor: وقرىء " بيس " كريس على قلب الهمزة ثم ادغامها و " بيس " بالتخفيف كهين وبائس كفاعل

BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r7.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r7.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r7.claim: Their punishment came because of their disobedience.

BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r10.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r10.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r10.claim: The surface sequence suggests severe punishment first and transformation after their later defiance; alternatively, the second verse explains and specifies the first.
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r10.anchor: والظاهر يقتضي أن الله تعالى عذبهم أولا بعذاب شديد فعتوا بعد ذلك فمسخهم

BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r11.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r11.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r11.claim: A report says the admonishers, despairing of reform, separated from the offenders with a wall and gate; when no offenders came out, they entered and found them transformed into apes. The apes did not recognize kin, but recognized the humans, circled them weeping and sniffing their clothes, and died after three days.
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r11.anchor: فقسموا القرية بجدار فيه باب مطروق، فأصبحوا يوما ولم يخرج إليهم أحد

BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r12.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r12.speaker: مجاهد
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r12.claim: Mujāhid says their hearts, not their bodies, were transformed into apes.
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:165/r12.anchor: وعن مجاهد مسخت قلوبهم لا أبدانهم

BIQAI-FULL:v3p140/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p140/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p140/r6.claim: When the sinners failed to return, God fulfilled the warning by bringing both severe punishment and destruction upon them.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p140/r6.anchor: أخبر أنه صدق ظنهم بإيقاع الأمرين معا

BIQAI-FULL:v3p140/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p140/r7.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p140/r7.claim: Their forgetting means they acted as if forgetful, abandoning the warning that God would not leave them free to do as they pleased.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p140/r7.anchor: فعلوا في اعراضهم عنه فعل الناسي وتركوه ترك المنسي

BIQAI-FULL:v3p140/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p140/r8.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p140/r8.claim: God saved those who continued to forbid evil.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p140/r8.anchor: الذين ينهون } أي استمروا على النهي

BIQAI-FULL:v3p140/r9.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p140/r9.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p140/r9.claim: The wrongdoers received a very severe punishment because they kept renewing their sinful conduct.

BURSEVI:v3p202/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p202/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p202/r3.claim: “Forgot” means they abandoned the admonitions and turned away completely, until none of them came to mind; the effect of forgetting names its cause, deliberate abandonment.
BURSEVI:v3p202/r3.anchor: تركوا ما ذكرهم به صلحاؤهم ترك الناسي للشيء وأعرضوا عنه إعراضا كليا بحيث لم يخطر ببالهم شيء من تلك المواعظ أصلا فيكون من ذكر المسبب وإرادة السبب

BURSEVI:v3p202/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p202/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p202/r4.claim: Those saved from evil were the people who forbade fishing, namely the two groups mentioned earlier.
BURSEVI:v3p202/r4.anchor: أي : خلصنا الذين ينهون عن الاصطياد وهم الفريقان المذكوران

BURSEVI:v3p202/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p202/r5.speaker: ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما
BURSEVI:v3p202/r5.claim: Ibn Abbas says the accommodating group suffered what those who deemed the fishing lawful suffered; Hasan rejects this report.
BURSEVI:v3p202/r5.anchor: قال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما : نزل والله بالمداهن ما نزل بالمستحل.

BURSEVI:v3p202/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p202/r6.speaker: الحسن
BURSEVI:v3p202/r6.claim: Hasan says two groups escaped and one perished; he rejects Ibn Abbas’s report because even the third group warned them of the threatened punishment, and this best fits the verse.
BURSEVI:v3p202/r6.anchor: وقال الحسن : نجت فرقتان وهلكت فرقة وأنكر القول الذي ذكر له عن ابن عباس

BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r1.claim: The wrongdoers were those who transgressed and disobeyed the command.
BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r1.anchor: وأخذنا الذين ظلموا} بالاعتداء ومخالفة الأمر

BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r2.claim: “Bais” means severe in both form and sense.
BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r2.anchor: بعذابا بئيس} أي : شديد وزنا ومعنى

BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r3.claim: The causal phrase attaches to “We seized,” like the earlier preposition, without conflict because the two prepositions differ in meaning.
BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r3.anchor: متعلق بأخذنا كالباء الأولى ولا ضير فيه لاختلافهما معنى

BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r4.claim: God seized them with the severe punishment because they persisted in fisq, departing from obedience through injustice and aggression.
BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r4.anchor: بسبب تماديهم في الفسق الذي هو الخروج عن الطاعة وهو الظلم والعدوان أيضا

BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r5.claim: Their first severe punishment may not have exterminated them: they continued and increased in error, so God later transformed them.
BURSEVI:v3p202#2/r5.anchor: ولعله تعالى قد عذبهم بعذاب شديد دون الاستئصال فلم يقلعوا عما كانوا عليه ، بل ازدادوا في الغي فمسخهم بعد ذلك

DURR-FULL:v3p588#2/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v3p588#2/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v3p588#2/r7.claim: Ibn Abbas glosses bāʾīs as painful and grievous.
DURR-FULL:v3p588#2/r7.anchor: ثم قرأ ابن عباس {فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به أنجينا الذين ينهون عن السوء وأخذنا الذين ظلموا بعذاب بئيس} قال: أليم وجيع

DURR-FULL:v3p590/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v3p590/r8.speaker: أبو بكر بن عياش
DURR-FULL:v3p590/r8.claim: Abu Bakr ibn Ayyash recalled Asim's reading بئيس on the pattern faʿīl, then doubted that transmission and instead took it from al-Aʿmash.
DURR-FULL:v3p590/r8.anchor: عن أبي بكر بن عياش قال: كان حفظي عن عاصم (بعذاب بئيس)

DURR-FULL:v3p591/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v3p591/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v3p591/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas glosses بئيس as punishment without mercy.
DURR-FULL:v3p591/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله {بعذاب بئيس} قال: لا رحمة فيه

DURR-FULL:v3p591/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v3p591/r3.speaker: مجاهد
DURR-FULL:v3p591/r3.claim: Mujahid explains بئيس as intensely painful.
DURR-FULL:v3p591/r3.anchor: عن مجاهد في قوله {بعذاب بئيس} قال: أليم بشدة

IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas glosses their forgetting as abandoning what they had been reminded of.
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس قوله : فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به يعني تركوا ما ذكروا به

IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r2.speaker: ابن جريج
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r2.claim: Ibn Jurayj says they ignored the believers' admonition, including the question why they warned people God would destroy or punish.
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r2.anchor: قال ابن جريج في قوله : فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به قال : فلما نسوا موعظة المؤمنين اياهم

IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r3.claim: In one account from Ibn Abbas, the people divided into three groups, and only those who forbade the evil were saved; the others perished.
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r3.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قول الله عز وجل : انجينا الذين ينهون ، عن السوء قال : فكانوا ثلاثا ثلثا نهى

IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r4.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r4.claim: A second account from Ibn Abbas says both the admonishers and those who questioned them were saved, while the fish-catching sinners were destroyed and transformed into apes and swine.
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r4.anchor: عن ابن عباس : فلما وقع عليهم غضب الله نجت الطائفتان اللتان قالوا : لم تعظون قوما

IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r5.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r5.claim: Ibn Abbas reports that the admonishers found the people gone, then discovered the men and women transformed into recognizable apes; he links this to the punishment becoming a lesson in 7:166.
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1601#2/r5.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قول الله : واخذنا الذين ظلموا بعذاب بئيس قال : فاصبح الذين نهوا ، عن السوء

IBNABIHATIM:v5p1602/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1602/r1.speaker: مجاهد
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1602/r1.claim: Mujahid glosses the punishment as painful and severe.
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1602/r1.anchor: عن مجاهد قوله : بعذاب بئيس قال : اليم شديد

IBNABIHATIM:v5p1602/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1602/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1602/r2.claim: A report through Ikrima from Ibn Abbas glosses the punishment as painful and aching.
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1602/r2.anchor: عن عكرمة بن عباس بعذاب بئيس قال : اليم وجيع

IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p151/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p151/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p151/r1.claim: The verse abbreviates the groups’ prior history: the question shows they had objected after seeing admonition fail, while 7:165 identifies the warners as the rescued group and the wrongdoers as the punished group.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p151/r1.anchor: وقد أجملت الآية ما كان من الأمة القائلة إيجازا في الكلام ، اعتمادا على القرينة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p152/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p152/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p152/r4.claim: The pronoun in “they forgot” refers to the offending people; forgetting is figurative for turning away in a way that leads to forgetting.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p152/r4.anchor: وضمير { نسوا } عائد إلى { قوما } والنسيان مستعمل في الإعراض المفضي إلى النسيان

IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p152/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p152/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p152/r5.claim: Those who forbid evil are both admonishing groups mentioned in the preceding verse; the wrongdoers are the group whose destruction the questioners expected.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p152/r5.anchor: والذين ينهون عن السوء } هم الفريقان المذكوران في قوله آنفا { وإذ قالت أمة منهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p152/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p152/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p152/r6.claim: Wrongdoing here means disobedience that wrongs the self by failing to fulfill God’s right through obedience.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p152/r6.anchor: والظلم هنا بمعنى العصيان ، وهو ظلم النفس ، حق الله تعالى في عدم الامتثال لأمره

IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p152/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p152/r7.speaker: نافع وأبو جعفر
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p152/r7.claim: Nafi and Abu Ja'far read بيس with a kasra on bā, a long yā, and tanwin, from بئس with the hamza softened to yā, like ذيب from ذئب.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p152/r7.anchor: قرأه نافع وأبو جعفر بكسر الباء الموحدة مشبعة بياء تحتية ساكنة وبتنوين السين

IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r1.speaker: ابن عامر
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r1.claim: Ibn Amir reads بئس with a still hamza and tanwin, deriving it from بئيس.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r1.anchor: وقرأه ابن عامر { بئس } بالهمزة الساكنة وإبقاء التنوين على أن أصله بئيس

IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r2.speaker: الجمهور
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r2.claim: The majority read بئيس with open bā, kasra on hamza, a still yā, and tanwin; it is either an intensive adjective from misery or a verbal noun like عذير and نكير.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r2.anchor: وقرأه الجمهور { بئيس } بفتح الموحدة وهمزة مكسورة بعدها تحتية ساكنة وتنوين السين

IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r3.speaker: أبو بكر عن عاصم
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r3.claim: Abu Bakr from Asim reads بيئس on the pattern صيقل, an intensive name for one characterized by hardship.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r3.anchor: وقرأه أبو بكر عن عاصم { بيئس } بوزن صيقل ، على أنه اسم للموصوف بفعل البؤس مبالغة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r4.claim: All these readings convey a torment causing severe harm.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r4.anchor: والمعنى ، على جميع القراءات : أنه عذاب شديد الضر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r5.speaker: قيل
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r5.claim: One view makes the severe torment a punishment before metamorphosis: the people who ignored admonition first suffer hardship, then witnesses who persist in defiance suffer the harsher transformation.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r5.anchor: فقيل هو عذاب غير المسخ المذكور بعده ، وهو عذاب أصيب به الذين نسوا ما ذكروا به

IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r6.speaker: قيل
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r6.claim: A second view identifies the severe torment with metamorphosis itself; 7:166 then explains it, while restating the people's forgetfulness and defiance to stress their concurrence.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r6.anchor: وقيل : العذاب البئس هو المسخ ، فيكون قوله : { فلما عتوا عما نهوا عنه } بيانا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r7.claim: The admonition they forgot and the prohibition they transgressed refer to the same thing; the expanded phrasing heightens the punishment and multiplies its forms instead of repeating words.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r7.anchor: و { ما ذكروا به } و { ما نهوا عنه } ما صدقهما شيء واحد ، فكان مقتضى الظاهر أن يقال

IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r8.speaker: لبيد
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r8.claim: Ibn Ashur compares the verse’s amplification to Labid’s repeated simile, but judges the Qur'anic wording more eloquent and more beneficial.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p153/r8.anchor: وهذا كإعادة التشبيه في قول لبيد : فتنازعا سبطا يطير ظلاله كدخان مشعلة يشب ضرامها

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p468/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p468/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p468/r4.claim: Ibn Abbas says the group that neither sinned nor admonished perished with the sinners as punishment for failing to forbid wrong; he also says he does not know what happened to them.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p468/r4.anchor: فقالت فرقة إن الطائفة التي لم تعص ولم تنه هلكت مع العاصية عقوبة على ترك النهي، قاله ابن عباس

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p468/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p468/r5.speaker: عكرمة والحسن وغيرهما
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p468/r5.claim: Ikrima, Hasan, and others say the neutral group was saved with the admonishers because it neither sinned nor approved the sin.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p468/r5.anchor: وقالت فرقة بل نجت مع الناهية لأنها لم تعص ولا رضيت قاله عكرمة والحسن وغيرهما

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r1.claim: Nasū refers to those admonished; 'forgot' means they abandoned the warning, an emphatic description since forgetting is the strongest form of leaving something.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r1.anchor: والضمير في قوله: نسوا للمنهيين وهو ترك سمي نسيانا مبالغة إذ أقوى منازل الترك أن ينسى المتروك

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r2.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r2.claim: Mā may mean that which they were reminded of, the act of reminding, or the subject matter of the reminder.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r2.anchor: وما في قوله: ما ذكروا به معنى الذي، ويحتمل أن يراد به الذكر نفسه، ويحتمل أن يراد به

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r3.claim: Al-sūʾ is generally all sins, but in this story it specifically means fishing for Sabbath fish.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r3.anchor: والسوء لفظ عام في جميع المعاصي إلا أن الذي يختص هنا بحسب قصص الآية صيد الحوت

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r4.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r4.claim: Those who wronged are the sinners.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r5.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r5.claim: Baʾīs means painful, grievous, and severe.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r5.anchor: بعذاب بئيس معناه مؤلم موجع شديد

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r6.speaker: نافع وأهل المدينة أبو جعفر وشيبة وغيرهما
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r6.claim: Nafi, the Medinans Abu Jaʿfar and Shayba, and others read bīs with kasra on bāʾ, still yāʾ, and kasra plus tanwīn on sīn; the word is treated as a verb used as a noun.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r6.anchor: وقرأ نافع وأهل المدينة أبو جعفر وشيبة وغيرهما «بيس» بكسر الباء وسكون الياء وكسر السين وتنوينها، وهذا على أنه فعل سمي به

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r7.speaker: الحسن بن أبي الحسن
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r7.claim: Hasan ibn Abi al-Hasan reads bīs like the phrase biʾsa al-rajul; Abu Hatim considers this weak.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r7.anchor: وقرأ الحسن بن أبي الحسن «بيس» كما تقول بيس الرجل وضعفها أبو حاتم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r8.speaker: الحسن
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r8.claim: Abu Amr reports from Hasan a form with hamza between bāʾ and sīn.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r8.anchor: قال أبو عمرو: وروي عن الحسن «بئس» بهمزة بين الباء والسين

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r9.speaker: نافع فيما يروي عنه خارجة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r9.claim: Kharija's transmission from Nafi has bīs with fatḥa on bāʾ, still yāʾ, and kasra plus tanwīn on sīn.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r9.anchor: وقرأ نافع فيما يروي عنه خارجة «بيس» بفتح الباء وسكون الياء وكسر السين منونة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r10.speaker: مالك بن دينار عن نصر بن عاصم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r10.claim: Malik ibn Dinar transmits from Nasr ibn Asim a form with fatḥa on bāʾ and yāʾ and tanwīn, on the pattern of jamal and jīl.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r10.anchor: وروى مالك بن دينار عن نصر بن عاصم «بيس» بفتح الباء والياء منونة على مثل جمل وجيل

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r11.speaker: أبو عبد الرحمن المقري
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r11.claim: Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Muqri reads biʾs with fatḥa on bāʾ, kasra on hamza, and tanwīn on sīn, on the fiʿl pattern.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r11.anchor: وقرأ أبو عبد الرحمن المقري «بئس» بفتح الباء وهمزة مكسورة وسين منونة على وزن فعل

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r12.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r12.speaker: عبد الله بن قيس الرقيات
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r12.claim: The line by Abd Allah ibn Qays al-Ruqayyat cites biʾs in the sense of hardship or affliction.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r13.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r13.speaker: أبو عمرو الداني
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r13.claim: Abu Amr al-Dani attributes the preceding biʾs reading to Nasr ibn Asim and Talha ibn Musarrif.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r13.anchor: قال أبو عمرو الداني هي قراءة نصر بن عاصم وطلحة بن مصرف

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r14.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r14.speaker: نصر
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r14.claim: A reading is also transmitted from Nasr as bīs with kasra on bāʾ and no hamza.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r14.anchor: بعذاب بئيس معناه مؤلم موجع شديد

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r15.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r15.speaker: الأعمش
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r15.claim: Al-Zahrawi reports from al-Aʿmash biʾs with fatḥa on bāʾ, a doubled kasra hamza, and kasra plus tanwīn on sīn.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r15.anchor: الباء مفتوحة والهمزة مكسورة مشددة والسين مكسورة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r16.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r16.speaker: فرقة عن يعقوب
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r16.claim: A group, reported by Abu Amr al-Dani from Yaqub, reads biʾs like the preceding form but with fatḥa on sīn.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r16.anchor: بعذاب بئيس معناه مؤلم موجع شديد

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r17.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r17.speaker: ابن كثير وأبو عمرو وحمزة والكسائي ونافع وعاصم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r17.claim: These readers use baʾīs with yāʾ after hamza, on the faʿīl pattern as an adjective formed from a verbal noun; Abu Hatim prefers this reading.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r17.anchor: وقرأ ابن كثير وأبو عمرو وحمزة والكسائي ونافع في رواية أبي قرة عنه وعاصم في رواية حفص عنه «بئيس»

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r18.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r18.speaker: ذو الإصبع العدواني
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r18.claim: The line by Dhu al-Asbaʿ al-Adwani witnesses baʾīs in the preferred faʿīl reading.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r18.anchor: بعذاب بئيس معناه مؤلم موجع شديد

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r19.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r19.speaker: أهل مكة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r19.claim: The Meccans read baʾīs like the faʿīl form but with kasra on bāʾ; Abu Hatim says both are dialects.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469/r19.anchor: بعذاب بئيس معناه مؤلم موجع شديد

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r1.speaker: عاصم في رواية أبي بكر والأعمش
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r1.claim: Asim in Abu Bakr's transmission and al-Aʿmash read bayʾas with fatḥa on bāʾ, still yāʾ, fatḥa on hamza, on the fayʿal pattern meaning severe.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r1.anchor: وقرأ عاصم في رواية أبي بكر عنه «بيئس» بفتح الباء وسكون الياء وفتح الهمزة على وزن فيعل ومعناه شديد

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r2.speaker: امرؤ القيس بن عابس الكندي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r2.claim: The line by Imru al-Qays ibn Abis al-Kindi witnesses the bayʾas reading.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r3.speaker: عيسى بن عمر والأعمش
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r3.claim: Isa ibn Umar and, in a variant, al-Aʿmash read bayʾis with kasra on hamza; Ibn ʿAṭiyya calls it anomalous because sound roots lack this pattern.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r3.anchor: وقرأ عيسى بن عمر والأعمش بخلاف عنه «بيئس» كالتي قبل إلا كسر الهمزة على وزن فيعل

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r4.speaker: نصر عن عاصم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r4.claim: Al-Zahrawi reports Nasr from Asim reading bīs on the pattern of mayyit, deriving it from al-baws rather than a hamzated root.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r4.anchor: وقال الزهراوي: روى نصر عن عاصم «بيس» على مثال ميت وهذا على أنه من البوس لا أصل له في الهمز

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r5.speaker: الحسن والأعمش
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r5.claim: Abu Hatim reports Isma that Hasan and al-Aʿmash read baʾīs with kasra on bāʾ, still hamza, and fatḥa on yāʾ; he weakens it.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r5.anchor: قال أبو حاتم زعم عصمة أن الحسن والأعمش قرءا «بئيس» الباء مكسورة والهمزة ساكنة والياء مفتوحة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r6.speaker: ابن عامر
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r6.claim: Ibn Amir reads biʾs with kasra on bāʾ, still hamza, and kasra plus tanwīn on sīn.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r6.anchor: وقرأ ابن عامر من السبعة «بئس» بكسر الباء وسكون الهمزة وتنوين السين المكسورة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r7.speaker: فرقة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r7.claim: A group reads baʾs with fatḥa on bāʾ and a still alif.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r7.anchor: وقرأت فرقة «بأس» بفتح الباء وسكون الألف

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r8.speaker: أبو رجاء
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r8.claim: Abu Raja reads bāʾis on the fāʿil pattern.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r8.anchor: وقرأ أبو رجاء «بائس» على وزن فاعل

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r9.speaker: فرقة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r9.claim: A group reads bīs with fatḥa on bāʾ, yāʾ, and sīn, on the fiʿl pattern.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r9.anchor: بفتح الباء والياء والسين على وزن فعل

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r10.speaker: مالك بن دينار
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r10.claim: Malik ibn Dinar reads baʾs with fatḥa on bāʾ and sīn, a still hamza, and the indeclinable faʿl pattern.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r10.anchor: وقرأ مالك بن دينار «بأس» بفتح الباء والسين وسكون الهمزة على وزن فعل غير مصروف

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r11.speaker: فرقة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r11.claim: A group also reads baʾs in the declinable form.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r11.anchor: وقوله: بما كانوا يفسقون أي لأجل ذلك وعقوبة عليه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r12.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r12.speaker: أبو الفتح
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r12.claim: Abu al-Fath attributes the form bīs to Nasr ibn Asim.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r12.anchor: وحكى أبو حاتم «بيس» قال أبو الفتح هي قراءة نصر بن عاصم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r13.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r13.speaker: ابن كثير وأهل مكة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r13.claim: Al-Zahrawi reports from Ibn Kathir and the Meccans bīs with kasra on bāʾ and a light hamza; Ibn ʿAṭiyya says its hamza vowel is unspecified.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r13.anchor: وحكى الزهراوي عن ابن كثير وأهل مكة «بيس» بكسر الباء ويهمز همزا خفيفا

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r14.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r14.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r14.claim: The punishment was imposed because of their sinful conduct and as requital for it.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p469#2/r14.anchor: وقوله: بما كانوا يفسقون أي لأجل ذلك وعقوبة عليه

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r1.claim: They abandoned the admonition given to them; God saved those who forbade evil and seized the Sabbath transgressors who did wrong.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r2.speaker: ابن كثير وأبو عمرو وحمزة والكسائي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r2.claim: These readers pronounce بئيس on the فعيل pattern, with hamza between bāʾ and yāʾ.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r2.anchor: قرأ ابن كثير وأبو عمرو وحمزة والكسائي بئيس على وزن فعيل

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r3.speaker: نافع
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r3.claim: Nāfiʿ reads بيس with kasra on bāʾ and no hamza.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r3.anchor: قرأ نافع بيس بكسر الباء من غير همز

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r4.speaker: ابن عامر
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r4.claim: Ibn ʿĀmir reads like Nāfiʿ but with a hamza.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r4.anchor: وقرأ ابن عامر كذلك إلا أنه همز

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r5.speaker: خارجة عن نافع
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r5.claim: Khārija reports from Nāfiʿ بيس with fatḥa on bāʾ, no hamza, on the فعل pattern.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r5.anchor: وروى خارجة عن نافع بيس بفتح الباء من غير همز على وزن فعل

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r6.speaker: أبو بكر عن عاصم
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r6.claim: Abū Bakr reports from ʿĀṣim the reading بيأس on the فيعل pattern.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r6.anchor: وروى أبو بكر عن عاصم بيأس على وزن فيعل

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r7.speaker: ابن عباس وأبو رزين وأيوب
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās, Abū Razīn, and Ayyūb read بيآس on the فيعال pattern.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r7.anchor: وقرأ ابن عباس وأبو رزين وأيوب بيآس على وزن فيعال

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r8.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r8.speaker: أبو عبد الرحمن السلمي ومعاذ القارئ
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r8.claim: Al-Sulamī and Muʿādh read بئس with fatḥa on bāʾ and kasra on hamza, without yāʾ, on the نعس pattern.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r8.anchor: بئس بفتح الباء وكسر الهمزة من غير ياء على وزن نعس

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r9.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r9.speaker: الضحاك وعكرمة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r9.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk and ʿIkrima read بيس with a doubled yāʾ, like قيّم.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r9.anchor: وقرأ الضحاك وعكرمة بيس بتشديد الياء مثل قيم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r10.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r10.speaker: أبو العالية وأبو مجلز
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r10.claim: Abū al-ʿĀliya and Abū Mijlaz read بئس with fatḥa on bāʾ, kasra on hamza, and no yāʾ or alif, on فعل.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r10.anchor: بئس بفتح الباء والسين وبهمزة مكسورة من غير ياء ولا ألف على وزن فعل

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r11.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r11.speaker: أبو المتوكل وأبو رجاء
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r11.claim: Abū al-Mutawakkil and Abū Rajāʾ read بائس with a long alif after bāʾ, on the فاعل pattern.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r11.anchor: بائس بألف ومدة بعد الباء وبهمزة مكسورة بوزن فاعل

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r12.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r12.speaker: أبو عبيدة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r12.claim: Abū ʿUbayda glosses البئيس as severe and cites a poetic line using بئيس as evidence.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r12.anchor: قال أبو عبيدة البئيس الشديد وأنشد حنقا علي وما ترى لي فيهم أثرا بئيسا

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r13.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r13.speaker: الزجاج
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r13.claim: Al-Zajjāj cites بئس يبأس بأسا and defines the defiant person as deeply corrupt and unwilling to accept admonition.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p277#3/r13.anchor: وقال الزجاج يقال بئس يبأس بأسا والعاتي الشديد الدخول في الفساد المتمرد الذي لا يقبل موعظة

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r1.claim: Ibn Kathir divides the village into Sabbath fishers, people who forbade them and withdrew, and a silent group that neither sinned nor forbade.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r1.anchor: صاروا إلى ثلاث فرق: فرقة (1) ارتكبت المحذور، واحتالوا على اصطياد السمك يوم السبت

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r6.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r6.claim: When the wrongdoers rejected counsel, God saved those forbidding evil and seized the Sabbath transgressors for their disobedience.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r6.anchor: فلما أبى الفاعلون المنكر قبول النصيحة، {أنجينا الذين ينهون عن السوء وأخذنا الذين ظلموا}

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r7.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r7.claim: The verse explicitly states the fate of the admonishers and wrongdoers but leaves the silent group unpraised and uncondemned; scholars differed whether they survived.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r7.anchor: وسكت عن الساكتين؛ لأن الجزاء من جنس العمل، فهم لا يستحقون مدحا فيمدحوا، ولا ارتكبوا عظيما فيذموا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r8.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r8.claim: Ibn Abbas, through Ali ibn Abi Talha, locates the village at Aylah between Egypt and Medina: fish appeared openly on the Sabbath and disappeared afterward; some Israelites caught them despite prohibition.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r8.anchor: قال علي بن أبي طلحة، عن ابن عباس: {وإذ قالت أمة منهم لم تعظون قوما الله مهلكهم أو معذبهم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r9.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r9.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r9.claim: In Ibn Abbas’s account, both groups of admonishers, including those who questioned further warnings, were saved; God turned the fish catchers into apes.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494/r9.anchor: قال علي بن أبي طلحة، عن ابن عباس: {وإذ قالت أمة منهم لم تعظون قوما الله مهلكهم أو معذبهم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r1.claim: Al-Awfi also transmits from Ibn Abbas an account close to the preceding report about the Sabbath village.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r1.anchor: وروى العوفي، عن ابن عباس قريبا من هذا.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas first said he did not know whether the questioners survived; after the narrator pressed him, he affirmed they did and gave him a cloak.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r2.anchor: عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس: {لم تعظون قوما الله مهلكهم أو معذبهم عذابا شديدا} قال: ما أدري أنجا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r3.claim: Ikrima recounts Ibn Abbas’s detailed Aylah story: Satan suggested taking Sabbath fish and eating them later, while another group held that catching them was also forbidden.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r3.anchor: قال عبد الرزاق: أخبرنا ابن جريج، حدثني رجل، عن عكرمة قال: جئت ابن عباس يوما وهو يبكي

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r5.claim: The same report says the city’s inhabitants were transformed into apes; apes recognized human relatives, approached them, and nodded when asked whether they had been warned.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r5.anchor: فعرفت القرود أنسابها (7) من الإنس، ولا تعرف الإنس أنسابها من القردة، فجعلت القرود يأتيها

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r6.claim: After reciting the verse, Ibn Abbas said he saw the warners saved but could not see the others mentioned, prompting the question whether silent disapproval sufficed.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p494#2/r6.anchor: قال: فأرى الذين نهوا قد نجوا، ولا أرى الآخرين ذكروا، ونحن نرى أشياء ننكرها ولا نقول فيها؟

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas’s report through Ibn Ishaq and Ikrima describes a man tying a fish on the Sabbath and openly eating it later while most people failed to object.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r1.anchor: قال محمد بن إسحاق، عن داود بن الحصين، عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس؛ أنه قال: ابتدعوا السبت فابتلوا فيه، فحرمت عليهم فيه الحيتان

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r2.claim: In this account Ibn Abbas divides them into thirds: warners, questioners who asked why admonish, and sinners; only the warners survived.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r2.anchor: قال ابن عباس: كانوا أثلاثا: ثلث نهوا، وثلث قالوا: {لم تعظون قوما الله مهلكهم}

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r3.speaker: مجاهد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r3.claim: Mujahid also transmitted the Ibn Abbas account of the Sabbath people.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r4.speaker: ابن رومان
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r4.claim: Ibn Ruman reports that a man tethered Sabbath fish until Sunday, then taught others the loophole; the practice spread and the city was struck by transformation.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r4.anchor: عن مالك، قال: زعم ابن رومان أن قوله تعالى: {تأتيهم حيتانهم يوم سبتهم شرعا ويوم لا يسبتون لا تأتيهم}

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r5.speaker: ابن رومان
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r5.claim: Ibn Ruman’s story continues that neighbors found the city closed and its people transformed into apes; the apes approached those they had known.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r5.anchor: وكانت لهم مدينة لها ربض يغلقونها عليهم، فأصابهم من المسخ ما أصابهم. فغدوا (4) عليهم جيرانهم مما كانوا (5) حولهم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r6.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r6.claim: Ibn Kathir says he had already presented sufficient reports about this village in his commentary on al-Baqara.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p495/r6.anchor: من الآثار في خبر هذه القرية ما فيه مقنع وكفاية،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p496/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p496/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p496/r1.claim: Although the alternative report has a good chain, Ibn Kathir prefers Ibn Abbas’s return to Ikrima’s view that the silent questioners survived, since their later status became clear.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p496/r1.anchor: وهذا إسناد جيد عن ابن عباس، ولكن رجوعه إلى قول عكرمة في نجاة الساكتين، أولى من القول بهذا؛

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p496/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p496/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p496/r2.claim: By implication, the people not included among those seized escaped the punishment.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p496/r2.anchor: فيه دلالة بالمفهوم على أن الذين بقوا نجوا.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p496/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p496/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p496/r3.claim: The word baʾīs has many variant readings.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p496/r3.anchor: و {بئيس} فيه قراءات كثيرة، ومعناه في قول مجاهد

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p496/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p496/r4.speaker: مجاهد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p496/r4.claim: Mujahid explains baʾīs as severe; another report from him gives the sense painful, and Qatada also says painful; Ibn Kathir considers these meanings close.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p496/r4.anchor: وقال قتادة: موجع. والكل متقارب، والله أعلم.

JISHUMI:v4p2757/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r4.claim: The commentator counts eleven readings for بئيس: five among the seven canonical readings and six outside them.
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r4.anchor: بئيس إحدى عشرة قراءة، خمس في السبع، وست خارج السبع

JISHUMI:v4p2757/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r5.speaker: أبو جعفر ونافع
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r5.claim: Abu Jaafar and Nafi read بيس with kasra on the yāʾ and no hamza, on the pattern فعل.

JISHUMI:v4p2757/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r6.speaker: خارجة عن نافع
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r6.claim: Another reading has kasra on bāʾ, a quiescent yāʾ, and no hamza, like ليل.

JISHUMI:v4p2757/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r7.speaker: ابن عامر
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r7.claim: Ibn Amir reads بئس with kasra on bāʾ and hamza, like بئر.
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r7.anchor: نحو: بئر، وهي قراءة ابن عامر

JISHUMI:v4p2757/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r8.speaker: أبو بكر عن عاصم
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r8.claim: Abu Bakr from Asim reads بيأس with fatḥa on bāʾ and hamza, on the pattern فيعل.
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r8.anchor: على وزن (فيعل) نحو: صيقل، أبو بكر عن عاصم

JISHUMI:v4p2757/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r9.speaker: ابن كثير وأبو عمرو وحفص عن عاصم وحمزة والكسائي ويعقوب
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r9.claim: These readers use بئيس on فعيل; this is the common and best-known form, and its adjectival pattern is preferred by Abu Ubayd and Abu Hatim.
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r9.anchor: ابن كثير، وأبو عمرو وحفص عن عاصم وحمزة والكسائي ويعقوب

JISHUMI:v4p2757/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r10.speaker: أبو عبيد وأبو حاتم
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r10.claim: Abu Ubayd and Abu Hatim prefer فعيل because it better fits adjectives and is the most familiar form.
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r10.anchor: وهو اختيار أبي عبيد وأبي حاتم؛ لأن فعيل أشبه بالصفات والنعوت

JISHUMI:v4p2757/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r11.speaker: ذو الأصبع العدواني
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r11.claim: Dhu al-Isba al-Adwani's line uses بئيس as evidence for the adjective reading.

JISHUMI:v4p2757/r12.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r12.speaker: الحسن
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r12.claim: Al-Hasan reads بيس with kasra on bāʾ and fatḥa on the final sīn, meaning the punishment is bad.
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r12.anchor: عن الحسن (بيس) بكسر الباء وفتح السين

JISHUMI:v4p2757/r13.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r13.speaker: مجاهد
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r13.claim: Mujahid reads بايس on the pattern فاعل.

JISHUMI:v4p2757/r14.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r14.speaker: أبي
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r14.claim: Ubayy reads بيس with fatḥa on bāʾ and yāʾ, without hamza, on فعل like جمل.

JISHUMI:v4p2757/r15.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r15.speaker: نصر بن عاصم
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r15.claim: Nasr ibn Asim reads بيس with fatḥa on bāʾ, a doubled kasra-yāʾ, and no hamza, on فعل like جيد.
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r15.anchor: عن نصر بن عاصم بفتح الباء وكسر الياء مشددا

JISHUMI:v4p2757/r16.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r16.speaker: بعض أهل مكة
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r16.claim: Some Meccans read بيس with kasra on bāʾ and no hamza, like ليل, on فعل.
JISHUMI:v4p2757/r16.anchor: عن بعض أهل مكة (بيس) بكسر الباء غير الهمزة

MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r1.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r1.claim: Here forgetting means abandoning the reminder, which was to enjoin right and forbid wrong.
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r1.anchor: نسوا يعني تركوا , والذي ذكروا به

MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r2.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r2.claim: Those saved were the people who enjoined good and forbade evil.
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r2.anchor: وهم الذين يأمرون بالمعروف وينهون عن المنكر

MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r3.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r3.claim: The wrongdoers were those who abandoned right conduct and committed evil.
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r3.anchor: وهم الذين تركوا المعروف وفعلوا المنكر

MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r4.speaker: مجاهد
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r4.anchor: بعذاب بئيس } فيه ثلاثة أوجه : أحدها : شديد , قاله مجاهد

MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r5.speaker: الأخفش
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r5.claim: Al-Akhfash glosses bʾīs as bad or vile.

MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r6.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r6.claim: A third gloss connects the punishment with poverty and misery.
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r6.anchor: أنه العذاب المقترن بالفقر وهو البؤس

MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r7.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r7.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r7.claim: One view holds that the silent group, who neither forbade evil nor committed it, was saved with the forbiders.
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r7.anchor: الفرقة الثالثة التي لم تنه ولم تفعل ففيها قولان : أحدهما : أنها نجيت مع الذين نهوا

MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r8.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r8.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r8.claim: Ibn Abbas says he does not know what happened to the silent group that neither forbade nor committed evil.
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p272/r8.anchor: والثاني : ما قاله ابن عباس : لا أدري ما فعل بها

MUJAHID:v1p248#2/r1.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v1p248#2/r1.speaker: مجاهد
MUJAHID:v1p248#2/r1.anchor: عن مجاهد ﴿ بعذاب بئيس ﴾ يعني أليما شديدا

MUQATIL:7:164-166/r5.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:7:164-166/r5.speaker: author
MUQATIL:7:164-166/r5.claim: They forgot what they were reminded of by abandoning the admonition about fishing.
MUQATIL:7:164-166/r5.anchor: { فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به } ، يعني فلما تركوا ما وعظوا به من أمر الحيتان،

MUQATIL:7:164-166/r6.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
