MUQATIL:7:164-166/r6.speaker: author
MUQATIL:7:164-166/r6.claim: God saved those who forbade evil, meaning sins.
MUQATIL:7:164-166/r6.anchor: { أنجينا } من العذاب { الذين ينهون عن السوء } ، يعني المعاصي،

MUQATIL:7:164-166/r7.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:7:164-166/r7.speaker: author
MUQATIL:7:164-166/r7.claim: God seized the wrongdoers with the punishment of transformation; “severe” means harsh and “they transgressed” means they disobeyed.
MUQATIL:7:164-166/r7.anchor: { وأخذنا الذين ظلموا } ، يعني وأصبنا الذين ظلموا، { بعذاب } ، يعني المسخ، { بئيس } ، يعني شديد،

NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r1.claim: Their forgetting means that the villagers abandoned what the righteous had reminded them about.
NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r1.anchor: أى أهل القرية لما تركوا ﴿ ما ذكروا به ﴾ ماذكرهم به الصالحون

NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r2.claim: God saved those who kept forbidding evil from the severe punishment.
NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r2.anchor: ﴿ أنجينا الذين ينهون عن السوء ﴾ من العذاب الشديد

NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r3.claim: The wrongdoers include the people who committed the offense; those who asked why the others preached were among the saved.
NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r3.anchor: الراكبين للمنكر والذين قالوا لم تعظون من الناجين فعن الحسن نجت فرقتان

NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r4.speaker: الحسن
NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r4.claim: Al-Ḥasan says two groups were saved and one destroyed: those who caught the fish.

NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r5.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r5.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r5.claim: Bāʾīs means severe, from the verb describing something becoming intense.
NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r5.anchor: شديد يقال يؤس يبؤء بأسا إذا اشتد فهو بئيس

NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r6.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r6.speaker: شامى ومدنى وأبو بكر
NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r6.claim: The passage reports Shami, Medinan, and Abū Bakr variants for the word bāʾīs.
NASAFI-FULL:v2p43#3/r6.anchor: فهو بئيس بئس شامى بيس مدنى على وزن فيعل أبو بكر

QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r1.claim: Forgetting here means deliberately abandoning the reminder, as in 9:67.
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r1.anchor: والعامد: التارك لقوله تعالى: { فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به } أي تركوه عن قصد

QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r3.speaker: أبو عمرو وحمزة والكسائي
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r3.claim: These readers pronounce بئيس on the فعيل pattern.
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r3.anchor: قراءة أبي عمرو وحمزة والكسائي «بئيس» على وزن فعيل.

QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r4.speaker: أهل مكة
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r4.claim: The Meccans read بئيس with kasra on its first letter, on the same pattern.
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r4.anchor: قراءة أهل مكة «بئيس» بكسر الباء والوزن واحد.

QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r5.speaker: أهل المدينة
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r5.claim: The Medinan reading is بيس, with kasra bāʾ, still yāʾ, kasra sīn, and nunation.
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r5.anchor: قراءة أهل المدينة «بيس» الباء مكسورة بعدها ياء ساكنة بعدها سين مكسورة منونة

QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r6.speaker: الكسائي
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r6.claim: Al-Kisaʾi derives the Medinan form from بييس; two yāʾs met and one was dropped.
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r6.anchor: قال الكسائي: الأصل فيه «بييس» خفيفة الهمزة، فالتقت ياءان فحذفت إحداهما

QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r7.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r7.claim: Another derivation takes the Medinan form from بئس, with a light hamza and omitted kasra.
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r7.anchor: وقيل: أراد «بئس» على وزن فعل فكسر أوله وخفف الهمزة وحذف الكسرة

QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r8.speaker: الحسن
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r8.claim: Al-Hasan reads with kasra bāʾ, still hamza, and open sīn.
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r8.anchor: قراءة الحسن، الباء مكسورة بعدها همزة ساكنة بعدها سين مفتوحة.

QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r9.speaker: أبو حاتم
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r9.claim: Abu Hatim objects that al-Hasan's reading leaves بئس without its normal predicate.
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r9.anchor: فزعم أبو حاتم أنه لا وجه لها، قال: لأنه لا يقال مررت برجل بئس

QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r10.speaker: النحاس
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r10.claim: Al-Nahhas rejects Abu Hatim's objection: Arabic omits an understood noun, and this means a bad punishment.
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r10.anchor: قال النحاس: وهذا مردود من كلام أبي حاتم حكى النحويون: إن فعلت كذا وكذا فبها ونعمت

QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r11.speaker: أبو عبد الرحمن المقرىء
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r11.claim: Abu Abd al-Rahman reads بئس with open bāʾ and kasra hamza and sīn.
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r11.anchor: قرأ أبو عبد الرحمن المقرىء «بئس» الباء مفتوحة والهمزة مكسورة والسين مكسورة منونة

QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r12.speaker: يعقوب القارىء
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r12.claim: Yaqub reports a reading by some readers with open bāʾ, kasra hamza, and open sīn.
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r12.anchor: قال يعقوب القارىء: وجاء عن بعض القراء «بعذاب بئس» الباء مفتوحة والهمزة مكسورة والسين مفتوحة

QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r13.speaker: الأعمش
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r13.claim: Al-Aʿmash reads بيئس on the فيعل pattern.

QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r14.speaker: الأعمش
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r14.claim: Another al-Aʿmash form is بيأس on the فيعل pattern.

QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r15.speaker: الأعمش
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r15.claim: A third al-Aʿmash form is بئس with open bāʾ, doubled hamza, and kasra sīn.
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r15.anchor: قراءة الأعمش «بيئس» على وزن فيعل. وروى عنه «بيأس» على وزن فيعل. وروى عنه «بئس» بباء مفتوحة وهمزة مشددة مكسورة، والسين في كله مكسورة منونة

QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r16.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r16.speaker: نصر بن عاصم
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r16.claim: Nasr ibn Asim reads بيس with doubled yāʾ and no hamza.
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r16.anchor: قراءة نصر بن عاصم «بعذاب بيس» الباء مفتوحة والياء مشددة بغير همز

QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r17.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r17.speaker: بعض القراء
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r17.claim: A further reading has kasra bāʾ, still hamza, and open yāʾ.
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r17.anchor: قال يعقوب القارىء: وجاء عن بعض القراء «بئيس» الباء مكسورة بعدها همزة ساكنة بعدها ياء مفتوحة

QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r18.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r18.speaker: علي بن سليمان
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r18.claim: Ali ibn Sulayman cites بنات بيس for something bad, so this form means a bad punishment.
QURTUBI-FULL:7:165/r18.anchor: قال علي بن سليمان: العرب تقول جاء ببنات بيس أي بشيء رديء. فمعنى «بعذاب بيس» بعذاب رديء

RAZI-FULL:v15p32#2/r11.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v15p32#2/r11.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v15p32#2/r11.claim: One account divides the townspeople into offenders, admonishers, and a silent faction that rebukes admonition as pointless.
RAZI-FULL:v15p32#2/r11.anchor: أن أهل القرية منهم من صاد السمك وأقدم على ذلك الذنب ومنهم من لم يفعل ذلك

RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r1.speaker: الواحدي
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r1.claim: Al-Wāḥidī prefers the three-faction account: if admonishers addressed sinners, they would say perhaps you will fear God, not perhaps they will.
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r1.anchor: قال الواحدي : والقول الأول أصح ، لأنهم لو كانوا فرقتين وكان قوله : { معذرة إلى ربكم } خطابا

RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r2.claim: A second account has two factions: offenders who challenge the admonishers, and those who refrain from sin and warn them.
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r2.anchor: والقول الثاني : أن أهل القرية كانوا فرقتين : فرقة أقدمت على الذنب ، وفرقة أحجموا عنه ووعظوا الأولين

RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r3.claim: They abandoned the reminder as one neglects something forgotten; God saved those forbidding evil and seized the wrongdoers.
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r3.anchor: يعني : أنهم لما تركوا ما ذكرهم به الصالحون ترك الناسي لما ينساه ، أنجينا الذين ينهون عن السوء

RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r4.claim: The verse indicates that the transgressing faction perished and the faction forbidding evil was saved.
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r4.anchor: واعلم أن لفظ الآية يدل على أن الفرقة المتعدية هلكت ، والفرقة الناهية عن المنكر نجت .

RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r6.claim: Another report says sinners and silent critics perished while admonishers survived; Ibn ʿAbbās wept and warned that those silent about wrong also perish.
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r6.anchor: ونقل عنه أيضا : هلكت الفرقتان ونجت الناهية ، وكان ابن عباس إذا قرأ هذه الآية بكى

RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r7.speaker: الحسن
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r7.claim: Al-Ḥasan says the silent faction survived, so two factions were saved; critics stopped advising because they expected no benefit.
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r7.anchor: قال الحسن : الفرقة الساكتة ناجية ، فعلى هذا نجت فرقتان وهلكت الثالثة .

RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r8.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r8.claim: Forbidding evil is a communal duty that falls from others once some people perform it.
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r8.anchor: لأن النهي عن المنكر إنما يجب على الكفاية . فإذا قام به البعض سقط عن الباقين

RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r9.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r9.claim: The punishment described as baʾīs is severe and distinct from the later transformation.
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r9.anchor: ثم ذكر أنه تعالى أخذهم بعذاب بئيس ، والظاهر أن هذا العذاب غير المسخ المتأخر ذكره

RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r10.speaker: أبو علي
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r10.claim: Abū ʿAlī derives baʾīs as faʿīl from a verb meaning severe; the alternative from Abū Zayd links it to buʾs, poverty.
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r10.anchor: قال أبو علي : وفيه وجهان : الأول : أن يكون فعيلا من بؤس يبؤس بأسا إذا اشتد

RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r11.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r11.speaker: صاحب الكشاف
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r11.claim: Al-Kashshāf transmits six forms: baʾīs, biʾs, bīs, biʾyas, assimilated bīs, and lightened bīs.
RAZI-FULL:v15p33/r11.anchor: والسادسة : { * بيس } على تخفيف بيس كهين في هين ، وهذه القراآت نقلها صاحب ( الكشاف )

STUDYQURAN:7:165/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:7:165/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:7:165/r1.claim: When Sabbath violators disregarded admonitions, God saved those who forbade evil and punished the violators.
STUDYQURAN:7:165/r1.anchor: God punished the violators and saved those who forbade evil—that is, by exhorting their fellow Israelites to observe the Sabbath

STUDYQURAN:7:165/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:7:165/r2.speaker: commentators
STUDYQURAN:7:165/r2.claim: Commentators disagree about whether abstainers who did not admonish others were saved.
STUDYQURAN:7:165/r2.anchor: The commentators are divided on the fate of those who abstained both from fishing on the Sabbath and from forbidding others to do so

STUDYQURAN:7:165/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:7:165/r3.speaker: some commentators
STUDYQURAN:7:165/r3.claim: One reported view counts the people who abstained but did not admonish others among the saved.
STUDYQURAN:7:165/r3.anchor: some consider them to be among the saved

TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r1.claim: The Sabbath violators abandoned God's prohibition and disregarded the warning given by the admonishers, then treated the forbidden as lawful.
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r1.anchor: فلما تركت الطائفة التي اعتدت في السبت ما أمرها الله به من ترك الاعتداء فيه

TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r2.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r2.claim: God saved those who forbade evil, meaning disobedience to God and making forbidden things lawful.
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r2.anchor: أنجى الله الذين ينهون منهم عن السوء، يعني عن معصية الله، واستحلال ما حرمه

TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r3.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r3.claim: God seized and destroyed those who violated the Sabbath by treating forbidden fishing for and eating of fish as lawful.
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r3.anchor: وأخذ الله الذين اعتدوا في السبت فاستحلوا فيه ما حرم الله من صيد السمك وأكله

TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r4.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r4.claim: Bāʾīs means severe; fisq is disobeying God's command and leaving obedience for sin.
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r4.anchor: {بعذاب} [آل عمران: 21] شديد {بئيس بما كانوا يفسقون} [الأعراف: 165] يخالفون أمر الله

TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r5.speaker: ابن جريج
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r5.claim: Ibn Jurayj says they forgot the believers' admonition, referring to the group who asked why the people were being admonished.
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r5.anchor: عبد الرزاق، قال: أخبرنا ابن جريج، في قوله: " {فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به أنجينا الذين ينهون عن السوء} [الأعراف: 165] قال: فلما نسوا موعظة المؤمنين

TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r6.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās wonders what specific evil the admonishers had forbidden.
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r6.anchor: عن ابن عباس: " {أنجينا الذين ينهون عن السوء،} [الأعراف: 165] قال: يا ليت شعري ما السوء الذي نهوا عنه

TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r7.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r7.speaker: قراء أهل المدينة
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r7.claim: Most Medinan reciters read bīs with kasra on bāʾ, a light yāʾ, and no hamza, on the faʿl pattern.
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r7.anchor: فقرأته عامة قراء أهل المدينة: (بعذاب بيس) بكسر الباء وتخفيف الياء بغير همز، على مثال فعل

TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r8.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r8.speaker: بعض قراء الكوفة والبصرة
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r8.claim: Some Kufan and Basran readers use bāʾīs on faʿīl with fatḥa on bāʾ and lengthened kasra under hamza.
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r8.anchor: وقرأ ذلك بعض قراء الكوفة والبصرة: {بعذاب بئيس} [الأعراف: 165] على مثل فعيل من البؤس

TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r9.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r9.speaker: بعض المكيين
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r9.claim: Some Meccan readers use the same bāʾīs form but with kasra on bāʾ.
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r9.anchor: وقرأ ذلك كذلك بعض المكيين، غير أنه كسر باء: (بئيس) على مثال فعيل

TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r10.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r10.speaker: بعض الكوفيين
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r10.claim: Some Kufans read biʾs with a silent yāʾ and kasra on hamza; al-Ṭabarī calls it anomalous because non-weak fiyʿl normally has fatḥa on its middle radical.
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r10.anchor: وقرأه بعض الكوفيين: (بيئس) بفتح الباء، وتسكين الياء، وهمزة بعدها مكسورة، على مثال فيعل

TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r11.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r11.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r11.claim: He introduces a verse by Imruʾ al-Qays b. ʿĀbis as poetic evidence for the disputed kasra.
TAB-FULL:v10p524#2/r11.anchor: وقد أنشد بعضهم قول امرئ القيس بن عابس الكندي

TAB-FULL:v10p526/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r1.claim: Al-Ṭabarī cites Imruʾ al-Qays b. ʿĀbis's line as a witness to kasra in the fiyʿl form.
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r1.anchor: القونسا بكسر العين من فيعل، وهي الهمزة من بيئس

TAB-FULL:v10p526/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r2.speaker: آخر من الكوفيين
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r2.claim: Another Kufan reading opens bāʾ and hamza, with silent yāʾ, on fiyʿl like ṣayqal.
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r2.anchor: ذكر عن آخر من الكوفيين أيضا أنه قرأه: «بيئس» نحو القراءة التي ذكرناها قبل هذه، وذلك بفتح الباء وتسكين الياء وفتح الهمزة بعد الياء

TAB-FULL:v10p526/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r3.speaker: بعض البصريين
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r3.claim: Some Basrans read biʾs on faʿl, with fatḥa on bāʾ and kasra under hamza.
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r3.anchor: وروي عن بعض البصريين أنه قرأه: «بئس» بفتح الباء وكسر الهمزة على مثال فعل

TAB-FULL:v10p526/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r4.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r4.claim: Ibn Qays al-Ruqayyāt's verse supplies a poetic witness for the form biʾs.

TAB-FULL:v10p526/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r5.speaker: آخر منهم
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r5.claim: Another reader reads biʾs with kasra on bāʾ and fatḥa on sīn, meaning “bad is the punishment.”
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r5.anchor: وروي عن آخر منهم أنه قرأ: بئس بكسر الباء وفتح السين على معنى بئس العذاب

TAB-FULL:v10p526/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r6.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r6.claim: Al-Ṭabarī prefers bāʾīs with open bāʾ and lengthened kasra under hamza on faʿīl because exegetes agree it means severe.
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r6.anchor: وأولى هذه القراءات عندي بالصواب قراءة من قرأه: {بئيس} [الأعراف: 165] بفتح الباء وكسر الهمزة ومدها على مثال فعيل

TAB-FULL:v10p526/r7.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r7.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r7.claim: Dhū al-Aṣbaʿ al-ʿAdwānī's line uses bāʾīsan to support the meaning “severe.”
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r7.anchor: حنقا علي ولن ترى … لي فيهم أثرا بئيسا

TAB-FULL:v10p526/r8.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r8.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r8.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās, through ʿIkrima, glosses the punishment as painful and aching.
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r8.anchor: عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس، في قوله: " {وأخذنا الذين ظلموا بعذاب بئيس} [الأعراف: 165] أليم وجيع

TAB-FULL:v10p526/r9.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r9.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r9.claim: Mujāhid glosses the punishment as severe.
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r9.anchor: عن ابن أبي نجيح، عن مجاهد: " {بعذاب بئيس} [الأعراف: 165] قال: شديد

TAB-FULL:v10p526/r10.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r10.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r10.claim: In another report Mujāhid calls it painful and severe.
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r10.anchor: عن ابن أبي نجيح، عن مجاهد: " {بعذاب بئيس} [الأعراف: 165] أليم شديد

TAB-FULL:v10p526/r11.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r11.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r11.claim: Qatāda glosses the punishment as painful.
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r11.anchor: عن معمر، عن قتادة: " {بعذاب بئيس} [الأعراف: 165] قال: موجع

TAB-FULL:v10p526/r12.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r12.speaker: ابن زيد
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r12.claim: Ibn Zayd glosses it as severe punishment.
TAB-FULL:v10p526/r12.anchor: قال ابن زيد: " {بعذاب بئيس} [الأعراف: 165] قال: بعذاب شديد

TABATABAI:7:161-165/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:161-165/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:7:161-165/r1.claim: These episodes recount earlier Israelites breaking God's commands and covenant and being punished; later generations inherited their scripture but traded its signs cheaply and relaxed religious observance, with only a few remaining true.
TABATABAI:7:161-165/r1.anchor: بيان قصص أخرى من قصص بني إسرائيل فسقوا فيها عن أمر الله

TABATABAI:7:164-166/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:164-166/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:7:164-166/r2.claim: Their forgetting means the reminder ceased to affect them, not that they literally forgot it; divine punishment follows disdain for God's command and turning away from remembrance.
TABATABAI:7:164-166/r2.anchor: المراد بنسيانهم ما ذكروا انقطاع تأثير الذكر في نفوسهم وإن كانوا ذاكرين لنفس التذكر حقيقة

TABATABAI:7:164-166/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:164-166/r3.speaker: author
TABATABAI:7:164-166/r3.claim: Repeated sin first causes inner pain, then repetition strengthens the sinful image and weakens the reminder until it has no effect, as though forgotten.
TABATABAI:7:164-166/r3.anchor: كلما عاد إليها وتكررت منه المخالفة زادت تلك قوة وهذه ضعفا حتى يزول أثر التذكير من أصله

TABATABAI:7:164-166/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:164-166/r4.speaker: author
TABATABAI:7:164-166/r4.claim: Only those who forbade evil were saved; God seized both the Sabbath transgressors and those who asked why they should be admonished.
TABATABAI:7:164-166/r4.anchor: دلالة على أن الناجين كانوا هم الناهين عن السوء فقط، وقد أخذ الله الباقين

TABATABAI:7:164-166/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:164-166/r5.speaker: author
TABATABAI:7:164-166/r5.claim: The questioners shared in the transgressors' wrongdoing because they abandoned admonition and did not separate themselves from them.
TABATABAI:7:164-166/r5.anchor: وفيه دلالة على أن اللائمين كانوا مشاركين للعادين في ظلمهم وفسقهم حيث تركوا عظتهم ولم يهجروهم

TABATABAI:7:164-166/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:164-166/r6.speaker: author
TABATABAI:7:164-166/r6.claim: God's general rule is that failing to restrain wrongdoing, or to admonish or shun wrongdoers when restraint is impossible or ineffective, makes one complicit and liable to severe punishment.
TABATABAI:7:164-166/r6.anchor: سنة إلهية عامة وهي أن عدم ردع الظالمين عن ظلمهم

TABATABAI:7:170-171/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:170-171/r5.speaker: أبو جعفر عليه السلام
TABATABAI:7:170-171/r5.claim: Al-Bāqir, citing ʿAlī's book, says Sabbath fish were sent visibly; some exploited a loophole to catch them that day and eat later, while one faction warned and withdrew, another stayed silent, and the warners ultimately left town fearing shared punishment.
TABATABAI:7:170-171/r5.anchor: عن أبي جعفر عليه السلام قال وجدنا في كتاب علي عليه السلام أن قوما من أهل إيلة من قوم ثمود

TABRISI:7:165-166/r1.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:165-166/r1.speaker: author
TABRISI:7:165-166/r1.claim: The Medinese read bīs without hamza; Ibn ʿĀmir reads biʾs; Abū Bakr (not Ḥammād) reads bayiʾs; the rest read baʾīs.
TABRISI:7:165-166/r1.anchor: القراءة: قرأ أهل المدينة بعذاب بيس بكسر الباء غير مهموز

TABRISI:7:165-166/r2.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:165-166/r2.speaker: author
TABRISI:7:165-166/r2.claim: Noncanonical readings include bayiʾs from Ibn ʿAbbās; biʾs from Zayd b. Thābit, Yaḥyā, al-Sulamī, and al-Ḥasan; bīs from Ṭalḥa and reportedly Nāfiʿ; bāʾis from Mujāhid.
TABRISI:7:165-166/r2.anchor: وروي في الشواذ عن ابن عباس بيئس على وزن فيعل

TABRISI:7:165-166/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:165-166/r3.speaker: author
TABRISI:7:165-166/r3.claim: Baʾīs can be an adjective on faʿīl from bāʾusa, meaning severe, or a maṣdar used adjectivally, as in al-nadhīr and al-nakīr.
TABRISI:7:165-166/r3.anchor: من قرأ بئيس فإنه يحتمل أمرين أن يكون فعيلا من بؤس يبؤس إذا كان شديد البأس

TABRISI:7:165-166/r4.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:165-166/r4.speaker: author
TABRISI:7:165-166/r4.claim: The biʾs reading treats the normally verbal form as a noun and adjective, like qīl and qāl.
TABRISI:7:165-166/r4.anchor: ومن قرأ بعذاب بئس فإنه جعل بئس الذي هو فعل اسما فوصف به

TABRISI:7:165-166/r5.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:165-166/r5.speaker: author
TABRISI:7:165-166/r5.claim: Bayyiʾs is analyzed as fayʿal, analogous to ḍaygham and ḥaydar; this pattern is normally for a weak second radical, so this form is judged an error.
TABRISI:7:165-166/r5.anchor: ولا يجوز كسر العين منه لأن فيعل بناء اختص به ما كان عينه ياء أو واوا

TABRISI:7:165-166/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:165-166/r6.speaker: ابن جني
TABRISI:7:165-166/r6.claim: Ibn Jinnī explains the hamza in the variant by its resemblance to the two weak letters.
TABRISI:7:165-166/r6.anchor: قال ابن جني: وإنما جاء في الهمز لمشابهتها حرفي العلة

TABRISI:7:165-166/r7.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:165-166/r7.speaker: author
TABRISI:7:165-166/r7.claim: Biʾs on faʿl may suggest biʾsa al-rajulu baʾsatan, “the man was courageous,” implying punishment came promptly; it may instead be shortened from baʾīs.
TABRISI:7:165-166/r7.anchor: وأما بئس على فعل فإنه جاء على بئس الرجل بأسة إذا شجع

TABRISI:7:165-166/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:165-166/r8.speaker: author
TABRISI:7:165-166/r8.claim: Bīs is explained as a softened hamza in biʾs, moved toward yāʾ; Ibn Mayyāda illustrates the softened pronunciation of yawmaʾidhin.
TABRISI:7:165-166/r8.anchor: وأما بيس في وزن جيش فكأنه أراد بئس فخفف الهمزة

TABRISI:7:165-166/r9.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:165-166/r9.speaker: أبو حاتم
TABRISI:7:165-166/r9.claim: Abū Ḥātim rejects al-Ḥasan’s biʾs reading, arguing it would require mā after it, as in niʿma mā.
TABRISI:7:165-166/r9.anchor: وأنكر أبو حاتم قراءة الحسن بئس

TABRISI:7:165-166/r10.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:165-166/r10.speaker: أبو زيد
TABRISI:7:165-166/r10.claim: Abū Zayd distinguishes bāʾusa for being mighty or brave from biʾsa in poverty; baʾsāʾ is a noun for hardship or poverty.
TABRISI:7:165-166/r10.anchor: قال أبو زيد: يقال بؤس الرجل يبؤس بأسا إذا كان شديد البأس

TABRISI:7:165-166/r13.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:165-166/r13.speaker: author
TABRISI:7:165-166/r13.claim: They abandoned the admonition and continued fishing; God rescued those forbidding evil and punished the wrongdoers for disobedience.
TABRISI:7:165-166/r13.anchor: فلما ترك أهل هذه القرية ما ذكرهم الواعظون به ولم ينتهوا عن ارتكاب المعصية

TABRISI:7:165-166/r14.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:165-166/r14.speaker: الجبائي
TABRISI:7:165-166/r14.claim: Al-Jubbāʾī says the severe punishment struck them before they were transformed into apes.
TABRISI:7:165-166/r14.anchor: وذلك العذاب لحقهم قبل أن مسخوا قردة عن الجبائي

TABRISI:7:165-166/r15.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:165-166/r15.speaker: السدي
TABRISI:7:165-166/r15.claim: Al-Suddī says the admonishers and silent observers were saved while the fishers perished.
TABRISI:7:165-166/r15.anchor: أحدها: أن نجت الفرقتان وهلكت الثالثة وبه قال السدي

TABRISI:7:165-166#2/r1.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:165-166#2/r1.speaker: ابن زيد
TABRISI:7:165-166#2/r1.claim: Ibn Zayd says the fishers and silent group perished and only the admonishers were saved; this is also related from Abū ʿAbd Allāh.
TABRISI:7:165-166#2/r1.anchor: والثاني: أنه هلكت الفرقتان ونجت الفرقة الناهية وبه قال ابن زيد

TABRISI:7:165-166#2/r2.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:165-166#2/r2.speaker: عكرمة
TABRISI:7:165-166#2/r2.claim: ʿIkrima reports Ibn ʿAbbās suspending judgment about the silent group; al-Jubbāʾī chooses this restraint.
TABRISI:7:165-166#2/r2.anchor: والثالث: التوقي فيه روي عن عكرمة

TABRISI:7:165-166#2/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:165-166#2/r3.speaker: الحسن
TABRISI:7:165-166#2/r3.claim: Al-Ḥasan says the third group was saved because warning with a threat is the strongest admonition and they did warn; killing a believer is graver than eating fish.
TABRISI:7:165-166#2/r3.anchor: وقال الحسن: إنه نجا الفرقة الثالثة لأنه ليس شيء أبلغ في الأمر بالمعروف

TABRISI:7:165-166#2/r16.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:165-166#2/r16.speaker: author
TABRISI:7:165-166#2/r16.claim: The admonishers separated from the others and would not live with them; one morning no offender emerged, and the others found them transformed.
TABRISI:7:165-166#2/r16.anchor: فاعتزلتهم الفرقة الناهية ولم تساكنهم فأصبحوا يوما ولم يخرج من العاصية أحد

THALABI:v4p296/r6.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p296/r6.speaker: ابن زيد
THALABI:v4p296/r6.claim: Ibn Zayd says the groups were separated by a wall; after David cursed the wrongdoers, the admonishers found them transformed into monkeys, recognized their kin, and the monkeys wept and nodded that they had been warned.
THALABI:v4p296/r6.anchor: فقسموا القرية بجدار للمسلمين باب وللمعتدين باب ولعنهم داود (عليه السلام) فأصبح الناهون ذات يوم

THALABI:v4p297/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p297/r1.speaker: قتادة
THALABI:v4p297/r1.claim: Qatada says the young became monkeys, the old became swine, only those who forbade the sin escaped, and everyone else perished.
THALABI:v4p297/r1.anchor: قال قتادة: صار الشبان قردة والشيوخ خنازير فما نجا إلا الذين نهوا

THALABI:v4p297/r9.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p297/r9.speaker: author
THALABI:v4p297/r9.claim: Their ‘forgetting’ means abandoning the admonition they had been given.
THALABI:v4p297/r9.anchor: فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به تركوا ما وعظوا به أنجينا الذين ينهون عن السوء أي المعصية

THALABI:v4p297/r10.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p297/r10.speaker: author
THALABI:v4p297/r10.claim: The evil they forbade was disobedience.
THALABI:v4p297/r10.anchor: أنجينا الذين ينهون عن السوء أي المعصية وأخذنا الذين ظلموا

THALABI:v4p297/r11.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p297/r11.speaker: author
THALABI:v4p297/r11.claim: God punished the wrongdoers for violating the Sabbath and treating what He prohibited as lawful.
THALABI:v4p297/r11.anchor: وأخذنا الذين ظلموا أي عاقبنا باعتدائهم في السبت واستحلالهم ما حرم الله بعذاب

THALABI:v4p297/r12.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p297/r12.speaker: author
THALABI:v4p297/r12.claim: Bāʾīs means severe and painful, from baʾs, meaning severity; its verb is baʾusa yabʾasu.
THALABI:v4p297/r12.anchor: بعذاب بئيس شديد وجيع من البأس وهو الشدة والفعل منه بؤس يبئس، فاختلف القراء فيها

THALABI:v4p297/r13.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p297/r13.speaker: أهل المدينة
THALABI:v4p297/r13.claim: The Medinans read bīs with kasra on bāʾ, sukūn on yāʾ, and no hamza, on the faʿl pattern.
THALABI:v4p297/r13.anchor: فقرأ أهل المدينة بيس بكسر الباء وجزم الياء من غير همزة على وزن فعل،

THALABI:v4p297/r14.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p297/r14.speaker: ابن عامر
THALABI:v4p297/r14.claim: Ibn Amir reads the same faʿl pattern with a hamza.
THALABI:v4p297/r14.anchor: وقرأ ابن عامر كذلك على وزن فعل إلا أنه الهمزة.

THALABI:v4p297/r15.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p297/r15.speaker: عاصم في رواية أبي بكر
THALABI:v4p297/r15.claim: Asim in Abu Bakr’s transmission reads bayʾis with fatḥa on bāʾ, sukūn on yāʾ, and fatḥa on hamza, on the pattern fīʿal.
THALABI:v4p297/r15.anchor: وقرأ عاصم: في رواية أبي بكر: بيئس بفتح الباء وجزم الياء وفتح الهمزة على وزن فيعل

THALABI:v4p297#2/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p297#2/r1.speaker: الشاعر
THALABI:v4p297#2/r1.claim: An unnamed poet’s line uses bayʾisan as a witness for the reading under discussion.
THALABI:v4p297#2/r1.anchor: كلاهما كان رئيسا بيئسا … يضرب في الهيجاء منه القونسا

THALABI:v4p297#2/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p297#2/r2.speaker: بعضهم
THALABI:v4p297#2/r2.claim: Some read bayʾis with fatḥa on bāʾ and kasra on hamza on the faʿil pattern; Ibn Qays al-Ruqayyat’s verse is cited as witness.

THALABI:v4p297#2/r3.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p297#2/r3.speaker: الحسن
THALABI:v4p297#2/r3.claim: Al-Hasan reads it with kasra on bāʾ and fatḥa on sīn, meaning ‘the punishment is wretched.’
THALABI:v4p297#2/r3.anchor: وقرأ الحسن: بكسر الباء وفتح السين على معنى بيئس العذاب.

THALABI:v4p297#2/r4.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p297#2/r4.speaker: مجاهد
THALABI:v4p297#2/r4.claim: Mujahid reads bāʾis on the pattern fāʿil.
THALABI:v4p297#2/r4.anchor: وقرأ مجاهد: بائس على وزن فاعل

THALABI:v4p297#2/r5.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p297#2/r5.speaker: أبو أياس
THALABI:v4p297#2/r5.claim: Abu Iyas reads it with fatḥa on bāʾ and yāʾ, without hamza.
THALABI:v4p297#2/r5.anchor: وقرأ أبو أياس بفتح الباء والياء من غير همزة

THALABI:v4p297#2/r6.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p297#2/r6.speaker: نصر بن عاصم
THALABI:v4p297#2/r6.claim: Nasr ibn Asim reads it with fatḥa on bāʾ and a doubled kasra-yāʾ, without hamza.
THALABI:v4p297#2/r6.anchor: وقرأ نصر بن عاصم: بيئس بفتح الباء وكسر الياء مشددا من غير همزة

THALABI:v4p297#2/r7.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p297#2/r7.speaker: بعض أهل مكة
THALABI:v4p297#2/r7.claim: Some Meccans read it with kasra on yāʾ and hamza, like baʿr; grammarians allow a first-radical kasra when the second radical is guttural.

THALABI:v4p297#2/r8.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p297#2/r8.speaker: أهل اللغة
THALABI:v4p297#2/r8.claim: Arab grammarians say a form whose second radical is guttural may take kasra on its first radical.
THALABI:v4p297#2/r8.anchor: وقال أهل اللغة: كل فعل ثانية أحد حروف الحلق فإنه يجوز كسر أوله

THALABI:v4p297#2/r9.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p297#2/r9.speaker: الباقون
THALABI:v4p297#2/r9.claim: The remaining readers use bāʾīs on faʿīl; Abu Ubayd and Abu Hatim prefer it because the form resembles adjectives, as Dhu al-Isbaʿ’s verse illustrates.
THALABI:v4p297#2/r9.anchor: وقرأ الباقون بئيس على وزن فعيل وهو اختيار أبي عبيد وأبي حاتم لأن فعيلا أشبهه بصفات

THALABI:v4p297#2/r10.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p297#2/r10.speaker: ذو الإصبع العدواني
THALABI:v4p297#2/r10.claim: Dhu al-Isbaʿ al-Adwani’s poem is cited as a poetic witness for the faʿīl reading.
THALABI:v4p297#2/r10.anchor: لأن فعيلا أشبهه بصفات [التعريف] كقول ذي الإصبع العدواني:

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p412/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p412/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p412/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas says their disobedience to the Lord of the worlds brought them abandonment by God.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p412/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p412/r2.speaker: الزجاج
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p412/r2.claim: Al-Zajjaj says their persistent disobedience made their trial more severe.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas glosses forgetting the warning as leaving what they had been admonished to do.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r1.anchor: قال ابن عباس: (أي: تركوا ما وعظوا به)

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r2.claim: Those rescued are the group that forbade evil.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r3.speaker: ابن عباس عن عطاء بن السائب
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r3.claim: In one report, Ibn Abbas suspends judgment about the silent group: the verse mentions the people who forbade evil but does not say what happened to those who asked why they admonished.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r3.anchor: ابن عباس في رواية عطاء بن السائب (¬2): (أسمع الله يقول

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r4.claim: In another report, Ibn Abbas says there were three groups and only the admonishers survived; the quiet group and offenders both perished.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r4.anchor: وروي عنه أيضا أنه قال: (كانوا أثلاثا؛ ثلثا نهى

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r5.speaker: ابن زيد
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r5.claim: Ibn Zayd also says three groups existed: the admonishers survived and the offenders and quiet group perished; he calls this the Quran's strongest verse on abandoning the duty to forbid wrong.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r5.anchor: وهذا قول ابن زيد أيضا، قال: (كانوا ثلاث فرق

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r6.speaker: ابن جريج عن عكرمة
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r6.claim: Ikrima recounts visiting Ibn Abbas as he wept over the Qur'an and asked what became of the silent group; Ikrima argued that the admonishers' question implied disapproval and that the verse states neither rescue nor destruction for them, persuading Ibn Abbas that they survived.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r6.anchor: دخلت على ابن عباس وهو ينظر في المصحف ويبكي قبل أن يذهب بصره، فقلت: ما يبكيك

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r7.speaker: الحسن
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r7.claim: Al-Hasan says two groups were saved and one perished: the fishers who took the fish.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r7.anchor: نجت فرقتان، وهلكت فرقة، وهم الذين أخذوا الحيتان

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r8.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r8.speaker: يمان
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r8.claim: Yaman says both the admonishers and those who asked why they admonished were saved, while the disobedient were destroyed.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p416/r8.anchor: وقال يمان: (نجت الطائفتان؛ الذين قالوا: {لم تعظون}

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:165/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:165/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:165/r1.claim: Their forgetting means they abandoned the admonition.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:165/r1.anchor: { فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به } تركوا ما وعظوا به

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:165/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:165/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:165/r2.claim: God saved those who forbade wrongdoing.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:165/r2.anchor: أنجينا الذين ينهون عن السوء وأخذنا الذين ظلموا

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:165/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:165/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:165/r3.claim: God seized Sabbath transgressors with severe punishment, metamorphosis, for their disobedience.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:165/r3.anchor: أنجينا الذين ينهون عن السوء وأخذنا الذين ظلموا } اعتدوا في السبت { بعذاب بئيس } شديد، وهو المسخ

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r1.claim: Those who tried to stop evil were saved, persistent violators were punished for their wrongdoing, and the verse leaves the fate of the third group unstated.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r1.anchor: kötülüğü engellemeye çalışanlar kurtuluş müjdesine mazhar olmuşlar; onların uyarılarını dikkate almayıp Allah’ın hükümlerini çiğnemekte ısrar edenlerin de

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r2.speaker: bir görüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r2.claim: One reported view says those who failed to oppose evil share the wrongdoers’ fate and punishment.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r2.anchor: Bir görüşe göre kötülüklerle mücadele etmedikleri için bunlar da kötülerin âkıbetini paylaşacaklar

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r3.speaker: Abdullah b. Abbas
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas is reported either to have withheld judgment about the non-admonishers or, in another report, to have said they too would be punished.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r3.anchor: Abdullah b. Abbas bunlar hakkında görüş belirtmeme yolunu tutmuş (tevakkuf etmiş)

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r4.speaker: başka bir rivayet
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r4.claim: A separate report attributed to Ibn Abbas says the non-admonishers would also be punished.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r4.anchor: başka bir rivayete göre ise bunların da cezalandırılacaklarını söylemiştir

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r5.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r5.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r5.claim: The preferred view, also attributed to Hasan al-Basri, is that non-admonishers were saved because they recognized the offenders’ conduct as evil.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r5.anchor: Hasan-ı Basrî’nin de katıldığı söylenen ve bize göre daha mâkul olan diğer bir görüşe göre

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r6.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r6.speaker: Râzî
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r6.claim: Al-Razi supports that view by treating the duty to oppose wrongdoing, including through force as well as verbal or written criticism, as a collective obligation.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:165/r6.anchor: Râzî, bu görüşün doğruluğunu savunurken, kötülüklere –sözlü ve yazılı uyarı veya eleştiriye ek olarak– güç kullanarak karşı çıkma

NAHHAS:v2p157/r5.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v2p157/r5.speaker: أبو عمرو وحمزة والكسائي
NAHHAS:v2p157/r5.claim: Abū ʿAmr, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī read baʾīs on the faʿīl pattern.
NAHHAS:v2p157/r5.anchor: قرأ أبو عمرو وحمزة والكسائي ( بعذاب بئيس ) على وزن فعيل

NAHHAS:v2p157/r6.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v2p157/r6.speaker: أهل مكة
NAHHAS:v2p157/r6.claim: The Meccan readers pronounce the bāʾ of baʾīs with kasra, retaining the same pattern.
NAHHAS:v2p157/r6.anchor: وقرأ أهل مكة ( بعذاب بئيس ) بكسر الباء والوزن واحد

NAHHAS:v2p157/r7.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v2p157/r7.speaker: أهل المدينة
NAHHAS:v2p157/r7.claim: The Medinan reading is bīs, with kasra on bāʾ, a still yāʾ, and kasra tanwīn on sīn.
NAHHAS:v2p157/r7.anchor: وقرأ أهل المدينة ( بعذاب بيس ) الباء مكسورة وبعدها ياء ساكنة والسين مكسورة منونة

NAHHAS:v2p157/r8.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v2p157/r8.speaker: الحسن
NAHHAS:v2p157/r8.claim: Al-Ḥasan reads biʾsa, with kasra on bāʾ, a still hamza, and fatḥa on sīn.
NAHHAS:v2p157/r8.anchor: وقرأ الحسن ( بعذاب بئس بما ) الباء مكسورة وبعدها همزة ساكنة والسين مفتوحة

NAHHAS:v2p157/r9.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v2p157/r9.speaker: أبو عبد الرحمن المقرئ
NAHHAS:v2p157/r9.claim: Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Muqriʾ reads baʾsin with fatḥa on bāʾ, kasra on hamza, and kasra tanwīn on sīn.
NAHHAS:v2p157/r9.anchor: وقرأ أبو عبد الرحمن المقرىء ( بعذاب بئس ) الباء مفتوحة والهمزة مكسورة والسين مكسورة منونة

NAHHAS:v2p157/r10.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v2p157/r10.speaker: يعقوب القارئ
NAHHAS:v2p157/r10.claim: Yaʿqūb al-Qāriʾ transmits another reading from some reciters with fatḥa on bāʾ, kasra on hamza, and fatḥa on sīn.
NAHHAS:v2p157/r10.anchor: قال يعقوب القارىء عن بعض القراء ( بعذاب بئس ) الباء مفتوحة والهمزة مكسورة والسين مفتوحة

NAHHAS:v2p157/r11.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v2p157/r11.speaker: الأعمش
NAHHAS:v2p157/r11.claim: Al-Aʿmash reads bayʾis on the fayʿil pattern and is also reported with bayʾas and a doubled-ḥamza form.
NAHHAS:v2p157/r11.anchor: وقرأ الأعمش ( بعذاب بيئس ) على فيعل وروي عنه ( بيأس ) على فيعل وروي عنه ( بعذاب بئس )

NAHHAS:v2p157/r12.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v2p157/r12.speaker: نصر بن عاصم
NAHHAS:v2p157/r12.claim: Naṣr ibn ʿĀṣim reads bīs with fatḥa on bāʾ and doubled yāʾ, without hamza.
NAHHAS:v2p157/r12.anchor: وقرأ نصر بن عاصم ( بعذاب بيس ) الباء مفتوحة وبعدها ياء مشددة بغير همز

NAHHAS:v2p157/r13.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v2p157/r13.speaker: يعقوب القارئ
NAHHAS:v2p157/r13.claim: Yaʿqūb also transmits a reading with kasra on bāʾ, still hamza, and fatḥa on yāʾ.
NAHHAS:v2p157/r13.anchor: وجاء عن بعض القراء ( بعذاب بئيس ) الباء مكسورة وبعدها همزة ساكنة وبعدها ياء مفتوحة

NAHHAS:v2p157/r14.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v2p157/r14.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v2p157/r14.claim: Baʾīs derives from buʾs, “to become severe”; a variant takes kasra on the bāʾ because a kasra follows.
NAHHAS:v2p157/r14.anchor: ومن قرأ ( بئيس ) فهو عنده من بؤس فهو بئيس أي اشتد وكذا بئيس إلا أنه كسر الباء

NAHHAS:v2p157/r15.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v2p157/r15.speaker: الكسائي
NAHHAS:v2p157/r15.claim: Al-Kisāʾī derives the Medinan bīs from baʾīs by lightening hamza, then dropping one of two yāʾs and shifting its vowel to bāʾ.
NAHHAS:v2p157/r15.anchor: قال الكسائي في تقديرها بئيس ثم خففت الهمزة كما يعمل أهل المدينة فاجتمعت ياءان

NAHHAS:v2p157/r16.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v2p157/r16.speaker: محمد بن يزيد
NAHHAS:v2p157/r16.claim: Muḥammad ibn Yazīd derives bīs from biʾs: the bāʾ takes kasra from hamza, whose own kasra is then dropped as burdensome.
NAHHAS:v2p157/r16.anchor: وقال محمد بن يزيد الأصل بئس ثم كسرت الباء لكسرة الهمزة فصارت بئس

NAHHAS:v2p157/r17.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v2p157/r17.speaker: علي بن سليمان
NAHHAS:v2p157/r17.claim: ʿAlī ibn Sulaymān cites Arab usage banāt bīs, “worthless things,” for the meaning of bīs as a bad punishment.
NAHHAS:v2p157/r17.anchor: وقال علي بن سليمان العرب تقول جاء ببنات بيس أي بشيء رديء فمعنى بعذاب بيس بعذاب رديء

NAHHAS:v2p157/r18.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v2p157/r18.speaker: أبو حاتم
NAHHAS:v2p157/r18.claim: Abū Ḥātim rejects al-Ḥasan’s reading because biʾs cannot modify a noun without a construction like biʾsa al-rajulu or biʾsa rajulan; al-Naḥḥās answers that ellipsis is attested, yielding “a punishment, a vile punishment.”
NAHHAS:v2p157/r18.anchor: فزعم أبو حاتم أنه لا وجه لها قال لأنه لا يقال مررت برجل بئس حتى يقال بئس الرجل

NAHHAS:v2p157/r19.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v2p157/r19.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v2p157/r19.claim: Basran grammarians reject al-Aʿmash’s bayʾis as a descriptive pattern except with weak assimilated forms such as mayyit and sayyid; bayʾas is acceptable like ṣayraf and ḥaydar, while other forms are rare or restricted to weak roots.
NAHHAS:v2p157/r19.anchor: وقراءة الأعمش بيئس لا تجوز على قول البصريين لأنه لا يجيء مثل هذا في كلام العرب إلا في المعتل المدغم

TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r1.speaker: علي عليه السلام
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r1.claim: In a report about the transformed townspeople, Ali says he recognizes their human lineages among this community: they neither reject nor change wrongdoing, but abandon what they were commanded; God saved those who forbade evil and seized the wrongdoers.
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r1.anchor: فقال علي عليه السلام والذي فلق الحبة وبرء النسمة إني لأعرف أنسابها من هذه الأمة لا ينكرون ولا يغيرون

TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r2.speaker: أبو جعفر عليه السلام
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r2.claim: Al-Ayyashi transmits from Abu Ja'far (al-Baqir) this account of the town's punishment and says its inhabitants were a people of Thamud.
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r2.anchor: ورواه العياشي في تفسيره عن أبي عبيده عن أبي جعفر عليه السلام

TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r3.claim: Reports in al-Durr al-Manthur through Ikrima from Ibn Abbas identify the people in the verse as a Jewish clan from Aylah.
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r3.anchor: عن عكرمة عن ابن عباس غير أن فيها أن المذكورين في الآية حي من اليهود من أهل إيلة

TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r4.speaker: author
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r4.claim: Al-Tabataba'i considers it possible that the people were Arabs of Thamud who had entered Judaism because they lived near the Jewish community of Aylah.
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r4.anchor: وليس من البعيد أن يكونوا قوما من عرب ثمود دخلوا في دين اليهود لقرب دارهم وجوارهم

TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r5.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r5.claim: An unnamed view identifies the village as Midian.
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r5.anchor: وربما قيل إن القرية التي أشارت إليها الآية هي مدين

TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r6.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r6.claim: Another reported view identifies the village as Tiberias.

TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r7.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r7.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r7.claim: A further reported view identifies the village as Maqna, between Midian and Aynuna.
TABATABAI:7:161-171#2/r7.anchor: وقيل هي قرية يقال لها مقنا

TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r1.claim: The punishment of the wrongdoers may include those who stayed silent and failed to forbid evil, although only the fishers are explicitly named as seized.
TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r1.anchor: فلم يذكر في جانب النجاة إلا الذين ينهون عن السوء وأخذ في جانب الأخذ الذين ظلموا دون الذين صادوا

TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r4.speaker: أبو عبد الله عليه السلام
TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r4.claim: Al-Majmaʿ reports from Abu Abdillah that both offending factions perished while the faction that forbade evil was saved.
TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r4.anchor: وفي المجمع أنه هلكت الفرقتان، ونجت الفرقة الناهية. روي ذلك عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام

TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r6.speaker: أبو عبد الله عليه السلام
TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r6.claim: A report in al-Kafi divides the people into those who obeyed and enjoined good and were saved, those who obeyed but did not enjoin and were transformed, and those who did neither and perished.
TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r6.anchor: عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام في قوله تعالى { فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به أنجينا الذين ينهون عن السوء } قال كانوا ثلاثة أصناف

TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r9.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r9.speaker: أبو جعفر عليه السلام
TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r9.claim: Al-Saduq transmits through Talha the same three-part account: those who obeyed and enjoined were saved, those who obeyed without enjoining were transformed, and those who did neither perished.
TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r9.anchor: وقد رواها الصدوق بالسند بعينه عن طلحة عن أبي جعفر عليه السلام في الآية

TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r10.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r10.speaker: جعفر بن محمد عن أبيه عليهما السلام
TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r10.claim: Al-Ayyashi reports three groups: those who desisted and withdrew, those who stayed without sinning, and sinners; only those who desisted escaped, while Abu Jaʿfar reportedly said the abstainers became tiny particles.
TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r10.anchor: ورواها العياشي عن طلحة عن جعفر بن محمد عن أبيه عليهما السلام في الآية قال افترق القوم ثلاث فرق

TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r11.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r11.speaker: author
TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r11.claim: The variants appear to be one narration whose chain is weak and whose wording is confused and inconsistent.
TABATABAI:7:161-171#3/r11.anchor: والظاهر أنها جميعا رواية واحدة على ما في سندها من الضعف، وفي متنها من التشويش والاختلاف

ELMALILI:7:164-170/r11.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:7:164-170/r11.speaker: author
ELMALILI:7:164-170/r11.claim: When the people ignored the warnings, God rescued those who forbade evil and seized the wrongdoers for their habitual transgression.
ELMALILI:7:164-170/r11.anchor: o zaman {أَنجَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلسُّوٓءِ} kötülükten nehyeder olanları kurtardık.

ELMALILI:7:164-170/r12.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:7:164-170/r12.speaker: author
ELMALILI:7:164-170/r12.claim: The severe punishment may alternatively be understood as a punishment that wrings them with poverty.
ELMALILI:7:164-170/r12.anchor: diğer bir mânaca yoksullukla kıvrandıran bir azab ile

BURHAN:v1p199/r5.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p199/r5.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p199/r5.claim: Al-Aʿrāf is Meccan except three verses, beginning with the command to ask about the town and extending through the verse about the mountain being raised.
BURHAN:v1p199/r5.anchor: سورة الأعراف مكية إلا ثلاث آيات

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p448/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p448/r4.speaker: أهل التفسير
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p448/r4.claim: Here al-ʿadhāb refers to transformation of the wrongdoers into apes and swine.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p448/r4.anchor: والثاني : المسخ . ومنه قوله تعالى في الأعراف

MAJAZ:v1p231/r1.author: Abū ʿUbayda Maʿmar b. al-Muthannā
MAJAZ:v1p231/r1.speaker: author
MAJAZ:v1p231/r1.claim: Khāsiʾīn means driven away and expelled; khasāʾtuhu ʿannī and khasāʾa ʿannī describe driving someone or oneself away.
MAJAZ:v1p231/r1.anchor: «قردة خاسئين» (165) أي قاصين مبعدين، يقال: خسأته عنى وخسأ هو عنى

NASHR:v2p272/r12.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p272/r12.speaker: المدنيان وزيد عن الداجوني عن هشام
NASHR:v2p272/r12.claim: They read with a kasra on bāʾ and a still yāʾ, without hamza.
NASHR:v2p272/r12.anchor: فقرأ المدنيان وزيد عن الداجوني عن هشام بكسر الباء وياء ساكنة بعدها من غير همز

NASHR:v2p272/r13.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p272/r13.speaker: ابن عامر إلا زيدا عن الداجوني
NASHR:v2p272/r13.claim: Ibn Amir, except Zayd through al-Dajuni, uses the same form but hamz the yāʾ.
NASHR:v2p272/r13.anchor: وقرأ ابن عامر إلا زيدا عن الداجوني كذلك إلا همز الياء

NASHR:v2p272/r14.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p272/r14.speaker: أبو بكر
NASHR:v2p272/r14.claim: Abu Bakr reports that he first retained from Asim a biʾs form on the pattern fiʿl, then doubted it and took the bāʾīs form from al-Amash, like Hamza.
NASHR:v2p272/r14.anchor: فروى عنه الثقات قال: كان حفظي عن عاصم بيئس على مثال فيعل، ثم جاءني منها شك فتركت روايتها عن عاصم وأخذتها عن الأعمش بئيس مثل حمزة

NASHR:v2p272/r15.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p272/r15.speaker: أبو حمدون، نفطويه، أبو بكر بن حماد المتقي
NASHR:v2p272/r15.claim: This transmission from Abu Bakr has fatḥa on bāʾ, a still yāʾ, then an open hamza.
NASHR:v2p272/r15.anchor: وهو فتح الباء، ثم ياء ساكنة، ثم همزة مفتوحة أبو حمدون عن يحيى

NASHR:v2p272/r16.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p272/r16.speaker: العليمي، الأصم، الحربي عن أبي عون
NASHR:v2p272/r16.claim: This Abu Bakr transmission has fatḥa on bāʾ, kasra on hamza, and a following yāʾ, on faʿīl.
NASHR:v2p272/r16.anchor: وروى عنه الوجه الثاني، وهو فتح الباء وكسر الهمز وياء بعدها على وزن فعيل العليمي والأصم

NASHR:v2p272/r17.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p272/r17.speaker: القافلائي وخلف عن يحيى
NASHR:v2p272/r17.claim: Both Abu Bakr forms are transmitted through al-Qafilai, and Khalaf also transmits both from Yahya; al-Dani read both by al-Suraifini's route.
NASHR:v2p272/r17.anchor: وروى عنه الوجهين جميعا القافلائي عن الصريفيني عن يحيى، وكذلك روى خلف عن يحيى

NASHR:v2p272/r18.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p272/r18.speaker: الباقون
NASHR:v2p272/r18.claim: The remaining readers use the second Abu Bakr form, with a kasra on the hamza and yāʾ after it.
